groups.title_vi: Ô cảnh báo: chém chéo của Tốt Recruit
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: Telegraph marker for the Black Pawn Recruit's diagonal jab (telegraph 0.58 s). One file set covers ONE forward-diagonal cell; the engine flips it horizontally for the other cell. Drawn in the '\' orientation (top-left to bottom-right). This is the FIRST required telegraph of the whole game and must read on light and dark squares, near fallen pieces and while the player moves.
groups.details_en: Telegraph language: three stages of ONE shape, escalating. WARNING = anticipation: 1 px dark-orange outline inset 2 px from the cell edge, small orange dots, no fill (at most a 10% orange tint), the shape only faintly dotted. LOCKED = target committed: the shape fills with a coral-red diagonal hatch (2 px lines every 4 px, 40% alpha), the outline thickens to 2 px and four small corner brackets appear (the 'locked' cue shared by every shape). COMMIT = damage resolving: solid coral-red fill (about 70% alpha) with a bright cream core that fades over the 3 frames. All fills stay semi-transparent so the chess square underneath stays visible. HC (high-contrast) clips repeat the same stages with a 2 px cream outer keyline plus 1 px charcoal inner keyline, 2 px hatch lines and a heavier pattern glyph, so the cue never relies on colour alone. Every clip's frame 01 is also the reduced-motion still. Pawn = corner slashes is the shape identity. Art is drawn pointing EAST (east = right) where it has a direction; the engine rotates it in 90-degree steps or flips it. Transparent background, one marker per 32x32 cell, legible on both ivory and charcoal chess squares.
groups.avoid_en: No opaque fill that hides the chess square; no actor art; no board grid lines; no text or letters; no glow or bloom; no decoration that looks like damage; no red in the WARNING clip.
groups.palette_en: Danger coral red #d84a3a (lighter hatch highlight #ff9a75); anticipation dark orange #e0762a with pale-orange dots #ffcf9a; cream core #fff4d6. Red appears ONLY in LOCKED and COMMIT. High-contrast clips add a cream #fff4d6 outer keyline and a charcoal #1e2229 inner keyline. These are starting values; the game may tune the final colours later.
groups.notes_vi: Mỗi file là 1 khung 32x32, nền trong suốt. Vẽ nét chém '\' (trái-trên sang phải-dưới); game tự lật cho ô còn lại. Đỏ chỉ dùng ở bước khóa và ra đòn. Bản _hc là bản tương phản cao. Các clip _hc (tương phản cao) hạ xuống 'could': công cụ có thể sinh từ bản thường (viền kem + viền than + hoa văn dày hơn), chỉ vẽ tay nếu bản sinh ra chưa ổn. Mốc dời từ M8a về M6 vì T3/T4 (Act 1, M6) đã đặt Tốt, Tốt cầm vũ khí và Tốt lùi.

groups.details_en: Telegraph language: three stages of ONE shape, escalating. LOCKED = target committed: the shape fills with a coral-red diagonal hatch (2 px lines every 4 px, 40% alpha), the outline thickens to 2 px and four small corner brackets appear (the 'locked' cue shared by every shape). COMMIT = damage resolving: solid coral-red fill (about 70% alpha) with a bright cream core that fades over the 3 frames. All fills stay semi-transparent so the chess square underneath stays visible. HC (high-contrast) clips repeat the same stages with a 2 px cream outer keyline plus 1 px charcoal inner keyline, 2 px hatch lines and a heavier pattern glyph, so the cue never relies on colour alone. Every clip's frame 01 is also the reduced-motion still. Art is drawn pointing EAST (east = right) where it has a direction; the engine rotates it in 90-degree steps or flips it. Transparent background, one marker per 32x32 cell, legible on both ivory and charcoal chess squares.
groups.avoid_en: No opaque fill that hides the chess square; no actor art; no board grid lines; no text or letters; no glow or bloom; no decoration that looks like damage; no red in the WARNING clip.
groups.palette_en: Danger coral red #d84a3a (lighter hatch highlight #ff9a75); anticipation dark orange #e0762a with pale-orange dots #ffcf9a; cream core #fff4d6. Red appears ONLY in LOCKED and COMMIT. High-contrast clips add a cream #fff4d6 outer keyline and a charcoal #1e2229 inner keyline. These are starting values; the game may tune the final colours later.

Every clip's frame 01 is also the reduced-motion still. Art is drawn pointing EAST (east = right) where it has a direction; the engine rotates it in 90-degree steps or flips it. Transparent background, one marker per 32x32 cell, legible on both ivory and charcoal chess squares.

groups.title_vi: Ô cảnh báo: tia mũi tên của Xe (ô giữa)
groups.anchor: none: centred arrow band meets neighbouring cells exactly at the left and right edges (same rows)
groups.subject_en: Telegraph marker for a MIDDLE cell of a Rook lane. Drawn pointing east.
groups.details_en: Telegraph language: three stages of ONE shape, escalating. WARNING = anticipation: 1 px dark-orange outline inset 2 px from the cell edge, small orange dots, no fill (at most a 10% orange tint), the shape only faintly dotted. LOCKED = target committed: the shape fills with a coral-red diagonal hatch (2 px lines every 4 px, 40% alpha), the outline thickens to 2 px and four small corner brackets appear (the 'locked' cue shared by every shape). COMMIT = damage resolving: solid coral-red fill (about 70% alpha) with a bright cream core that fades over the 3 frames. All fills stay semi-transparent so the chess square underneath stays visible. HC (high-contrast) clips repeat the same stages with a 2 px cream outer keyline plus 1 px charcoal inner keyline, 2 px hatch lines and a heavier pattern glyph, so the cue never relies on colour alone. Every clip's frame 01 is also the reduced-motion still. Art is drawn pointing EAST (east = right) where it has a direction; the engine rotates it in 90-degree steps or flips it. Transparent background, one marker per 32x32 cell, legible on both ivory and charcoal chess squares.
groups.avoid_en: No opaque fill that hides the chess square; no actor art; no board grid lines; no text or letters; no glow or bloom; no decoration that looks like damage; no red in the WARNING clip.
groups.palette_en: Danger coral red #d84a3a (lighter hatch highlight #ff9a75); anticipation dark orange #e0762a with pale-orange dots #ffcf9a; cream core #fff4d6. Red appears ONLY in LOCKED and COMMIT. High-contrast clips add a cream #fff4d6 outer keyline and a charcoal #1e2229 inner keyline. These are starting values; the game may tune the final colours later.
groups.notes_vi: Ô giữa của tia. Các clip _hc (tương phản cao) hạ xuống 'could': công cụ có thể sinh từ bản thường (viền kem + viền than + hoa văn dày hơn), chỉ vẽ tay nếu bản sinh ra chưa ổn.

SAFE 3/3: outline dots marched again, corner dots at 65%, centre diamond 70% (slow breathing); loops to frame 1.
HC SAFE 1/3: solid 2 px mint outline with cream outer keyline and charcoal inner keyline, bold centre check-mark in mint.
HC SAFE 2/3: same, check-mark at 85% and outline strength 90%.
HC SAFE 3/3: same, check-mark at 70% and outline strength 80%; loops to frame 1.

groups.title_vi: Khung góc nhấn mạnh khi Focus
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); brackets hug the cell corners
groups.subject_en: Focus (hold or toggle) emphasises every live telegraph WITHOUT slowing time: four bold L-shaped corner brackets drawn just outside the telegraph shape. They sit on top of any telegraph cell while Focus is on. Pattern-based, so colour is not the only cue.
groups.details_en: Four corner L-brackets, 6 px arms, 2 px thick, drawn at the very corners of the cell (inset 1 px). Cream main colour with a charcoal 1 px inner keyline so they read on any square. A tiny 2 px square dot at each bracket's elbow.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no fill; no actor art; no text.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 brackets with charcoal #1e2229 keyline; elbow dots in pale orange #ffcf9a.
groups.notes_vi: Bốn khung góc nổi bật bật lên khi giữ Focus. Không làm chậm game.
groups.used_in: Focus mode on any room with telegraphs

poses_en: FOCUS 1/3: brackets at their resting size (6 px arms), elbow dots visible.
FOCUS 2/3: brackets pulled 1 px inward (arms 7 px), elbow dots brighter.
FOCUS 3/3: brackets back at rest, elbow dots dim; loops to frame 1.

groups.title_vi: Huy hiệu thứ tự làn (1, 2, 3 chấm)
groups.anchor: badge centre at (6,6)
groups.subject_en: A tiny corner badge that tells the order of sequential attacks (Twin Landing, Cross Corridor: two sequential charges, Queen lanes where one lane is live at a time). It uses dots instead of numerals so no text is needed. Sits in the top-left corner of the telegraph cell.
groups.details_en: A 12x12 round badge: a cream filled circle with a 1 px dark-orange outline, containing 1, 2 or 3 small dark dots in a row (never numerals). Pixel-clean.
groups.avoid_en: No numerals or letters; no red; no glow.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 disc, dark orange #e0762a outline, charcoal #1e2229 dots.
groups.notes_vi: Huy hiệu tròn nhỏ có 1, 2 hoặc 3 chấm để biết đòn nào đến trước.
groups.used_in: tbb P2 (Twin Landing), btb P2 (Cross Corridor), dhb lanes

files.name: order_2.png

groups.title_vi: Vòng sáng cảnh báo (quân nhỏ: Tốt)
groups.anchor: ring centre at (20,20), concentric with the actor's base
groups.subject_en: The TelegraphAura: a soft ring drawn around the base of a pawn-sized piece (Recruit, Armed, Backstep, Charging pawn) while it winds up an attack, then flashes on commit. It is the actor-attached half of the telegraph language (the cell markers are the board half). Top-down ring, slightly squashed vertically like a ground ring.
groups.details_en: Ring outer diameter about 36 px, 3 px thick, with a thin inner ring 4 px inside. Three tiny triangular tick marks at the north, south-west and south-east. Clips: 'windup' loops while telegraphing, 'commit' plays once at impact, 'recover' plays once when the piece becomes vulnerable (calmer, desaturated).
groups.avoid_en: No red in 'windup'; no actor art; no bloom; no fill.
groups.palette_en: Windup: pale orange #ffcf9a ring with dark orange #e0762a ticks. Commit: cream #fff4d6 flash with coral #d84a3a flecks. Recover: pale ivory ring at low alpha.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng sáng quanh chân quân khi chuẩn bị ra đòn. Thay cho warning_aura.png tạm hiện tại. Mốc dời từ M8a về M6 vì T3/T4 (Act 1, M6) đã đặt Tốt, Tốt cầm vũ khí và Tốt lùi.

poses_en: WINDUP 1/3: ring at full strength, ticks bright, ring slightly squashed (width x height 100% x 70%).
WINDUP 2/3: ring 4% larger, strength 85%, the three ticks rotated 2 px.
WINDUP 3/3: ring back at size, strength 70%; loops to frame 1.
COMMIT 1/3: ring expands 20% and flashes cream at 90% alpha, coral flecks on the ring.
COMMIT 2/3: ring expands to 140% at 50% alpha, flecks drifting outward.
COMMIT 3/3: ring at 170% size, 15% alpha, nearly gone.
RECOVER 1/3: small pale-ivory ring at 40% alpha, no ticks.
RECOVER 2/3: ring slowly shrinks 10% and fades to 25% alpha.
RECOVER 3/3: ring at 10% alpha, nearly gone.

WINDUP 3/3: ring back at size, strength 70%; loops to frame 1.

groups.title_vi: Vòng sáng cảnh báo (boss)
groups.anchor: ring centre at (48,48), concentric with the actor's base
groups.subject_en: The TelegraphAura: a soft ring drawn around the base of a boss (Captain, Knight Captain, Oracle, Warden, Queen, King) while it winds up an attack, then flashes on commit. It is the actor-attached half of the telegraph language (the cell markers are the board half). Top-down ring, slightly squashed vertically like a ground ring.
groups.details_en: Ring outer diameter about 92 px, 3 px thick, with a thin inner ring 4 px inside. Three tiny triangular tick marks at the north, south-west and south-east. Clips: 'windup' loops while telegraphing, 'commit' plays once at impact, 'recover' plays once when the piece becomes vulnerable (calmer, desaturated). The ring is an effect, not a body: it is deliberately larger than a one-cell boss and may extend beyond the footprint of any boss (one cell for five bosses and for the Rook Warden in phase 3, 2x2 cells for the Rook Warden in phases 1 and 2).
groups.avoid_en: No red in 'windup'; no actor art; no bloom; no fill.
groups.palette_en: Windup: pale orange #ffcf9a ring with dark orange #e0762a ticks. Commit: cream #fff4d6 flash with coral #d84a3a flecks. Recover: pale ivory ring at low alpha.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng sáng quanh chân quân khi chuẩn bị ra đòn. Thay cho warning_aura.png tạm hiện tại.

WINDUP 2/3: ring 4% larger, strength 85%, the three ticks rotated 2 px.
WINDUP 3/3: ring back at size, strength 70%; loops to frame 1.

groups.title_vi: Dấu '!' bút chì khi quân phát hiện người chơi
groups.anchor: mark base at (8,14), floats above the piece's head
groups.subject_en: A small hand-drawn exclamation mark above an enemy for the 'alert' clip (the moment it notices the pawn). Drawn like a pencil mark so it feels like the child's drawing, in dark orange (anticipation) rather than red.
groups.details_en: Exclamation mark 4 px wide by 10 px tall, 2 px stroke, slightly wobbly pencil line, with a tiny 1 px spark at each side of the head. Clip 'pop' plays once (squash in, hold, shrink).
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text letters; no glow.
groups.palette_en: Dark orange #e0762a stroke with a cream #fff4d6 1 px highlight.
groups.notes_vi: Dấu chấm than nhỏ như nét bút chì, màu cam đậm, không dùng đỏ.

poses_en: POP 1/4: tiny mark at 50% size, squashed (6 px tall).
POP 2/4: mark overshoots to 120% size, two side sparks.
POP 3/4: mark at 100% size, side sparks gone.
POP 4/4: mark at 100% size, 60% alpha (the engine then fades it out).

groups.title_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: Kiếm gỗ
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16), the centre of the hit cell
groups.subject_en: Impact spark for a Wooden Sword hit on an enemy. One bright frame, a short freeze, then fragments. Sword effects are pale yellow with two or three pixel fragments.
groups.details_en: Plays once at the centre of the struck cell. Frame 1 is the one pure-white (or near-white) frame; later frames shrink and thin out so the next grid state is readable within 0.33 s. Fragments are 1x1 to 3x2 px, never larger. Must not hide the telegraph cells or the actors.
groups.avoid_en: No gore; no red or coral; no blood; no smoke; no outlines; no text; do not cover the whole cell for more than frame 1.
groups.palette_en: Pale yellow #fff2a8 star; white #ffffff only on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: 1 khung trắng sáng nhất rồi các mảnh nhỏ bay ra và tan nhanh.

poses_en: SWORD HIT 1/5: a pure white 8-point starburst 24 px across at the centre with four short pale-yellow rays; no fragments yet.
SWORD HIT 2/5: starburst shrinks to 18 px and turns pale yellow with a white 6 px core; three 2 px square yellow fragments fly out at 20-degree offsets, 8 px from the centre.
SWORD HIT 3/5: starburst 12 px pale yellow; the fragments are now 2 px streaks 12 px from the centre.
SWORD HIT 4/5: a small 4-point star 8 px at 60% alpha; fragments are 1x1 dots 16 px from the centre.
SWORD HIT 5/5: only 3 single pixels at 18-20 px from the centre at 30% alpha; the centre is empty.

groups.title_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: Bút chì Pencil Thrust
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16), the centre of the hit cell
groups.subject_en: Impact spark for a Pencil Thrust hit. One bright frame, a short freeze, then fragments. Pencil Thrust is a graphite-gray shaft with a pale-blue speed line and a sharp impact.
groups.details_en: Plays once at the centre of the struck cell. Frame 1 is the one pure-white (or near-white) frame; later frames shrink and thin out so the next grid state is readable within 0.33 s. Fragments are 1x1 to 3x2 px, never larger. Must not hide the telegraph cells or the actors.
groups.avoid_en: No gore; no red or coral; no blood; no smoke; no outlines; no text; do not cover the whole cell for more than frame 1.
groups.palette_en: Graphite gray #6b7380 shards with pale blue #bfe3ff speed lines; white #ffffff only on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: 1 khung trắng sáng nhất rồi các mảnh nhỏ bay ra và tan nhanh.

poses_en: PENCIL HIT 1/5: a pure white sharp 4-point star (long vertical and horizontal points, 26 px) with a pale-blue 2 px horizontal speed line through it.
PENCIL HIT 2/5: star shrinks to 18 px, graphite-gray; two pale-blue speed lines 6 px long trail to the west; three 2x1 graphite shards fly out.
PENCIL HIT 3/5: star 12 px; graphite shards 2 px at 12 px from the centre; one speed line left at 50% alpha.
PENCIL HIT 4/5: small plus-shaped sparkle 8 px at 60% alpha; two single graphite pixels at 16 px.
PENCIL HIT 5/5: two faint pixels at 18 px at 30% alpha; centre empty.

groups.title_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: Lưỡi thước
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16), the centre of the hit cell
groups.subject_en: Impact spark for a Ruler Blade hit (used per struck cell of the sweep). One bright frame, a short freeze, then fragments. Wide pale-wood sweep: the fragments are tiny ruler tick marks.
groups.details_en: Plays once at the centre of the struck cell. Frame 1 is the one pure-white (or near-white) frame; later frames shrink and thin out so the next grid state is readable within 0.33 s. Fragments are 1x1 to 3x2 px, never larger. Must not hide the telegraph cells or the actors.
groups.avoid_en: No gore; no red or coral; no blood; no smoke; no outlines; no text; do not cover the whole cell for more than frame 1.
groups.palette_en: Pale wood yellow #f1d58a fragments with tiny dark tick lines; white #ffffff only on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: 1 khung trắng sáng nhất rồi các mảnh nhỏ bay ra và tan nhanh.

poses_en: RULER HIT 1/5: a pure white horizontal flash bar 28x8 px at the centre with a 4-point star on top.
RULER HIT 2/5: flash bar shrinks to 20x6 px, pale wood yellow; four 3x1 'tick mark' fragments fly out with a dark 1 px tick on each.
RULER HIT 3/5: bar 12x4 px; the tick fragments 10 px from the centre, fading.
RULER HIT 4/5: a small dot of 4 px at 50% alpha; two tick fragments at 16 px.
RULER HIT 5/5: one tick fragment at 20 px at 25% alpha; centre empty.

groups.title_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: pawn bị trúng đòn
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16), the centre of the hit cell
groups.subject_en: Impact spark for the player pawn taking damage (stronger than enemy hits; shake and desaturate flash are done by code). One bright frame, a short freeze, then fragments. Stronger and rounder than an enemy hit, but still no red: the aftermath of damage is cream and pale orange, because red is reserved for imminent damage.
groups.details_en: Plays once at the centre of the struck cell. Frame 1 is the one pure-white (or near-white) frame; later frames shrink and thin out so the next grid state is readable within 0.33 s. Fragments are 1x1 to 3x2 px, never larger. Must not hide the telegraph cells or the actors.

groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 and pale orange #ffcf9a; white #ffffff only on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: 1 khung trắng sáng nhất rồi các mảnh nhỏ bay ra và tan nhanh.

poses_en: PAWN HURT 1/5: a pure white round flash 26 px across with six short rays.
PAWN HURT 2/5: flash shrinks to 20 px cream; six 2 px square pale-orange fragments fly out evenly spaced at 9 px.
PAWN HURT 3/5: flash 14 px; the fragments are 2 px streaks at 14 px, a thin cream ring 22 px across at 50% alpha.
PAWN HURT 4/5: ring 28 px at 30% alpha, a small 6 px cream core; fragments are dots at 18 px.
PAWN HURT 5/5: only a faint ring at 12% alpha and two dots; centre empty.

groups.title_vi: Tia lửa va chạm nặng (đánh trúng boss)
groups.anchor: burst centre at (24,24), the centre of the hit cell
groups.subject_en: Impact spark for a hit on a boss or a charged heavy blow. One bright frame, a short freeze, then fragments. Bigger, with a ring and eight fragments, still no gore.
groups.details_en: Plays once at the centre of the struck cell. Frame 1 is the one pure-white (or near-white) frame; later frames shrink and thin out so the next grid state is readable within 0.33 s. Fragments are 1x1 to 3x2 px, never larger. Must not hide the telegraph cells or the actors.

groups.palette_en: Pale yellow #fff2a8 with cream #fff4d6 ring; white #ffffff only on frames 1-2.
groups.notes_vi: Tia lửa va chạm: 1 khung trắng sáng nhất rồi các mảnh nhỏ bay ra và tan nhanh.

poses_en: HEAVY HIT 1/6: a pure white 12-point starburst 42 px across, nothing else.
HEAVY HIT 2/6: starburst 34 px, white core, pale-yellow rays; eight 3x3 fragments at 12 px.
HEAVY HIT 3/6: starburst 24 px; a cream ring 40 px across at 70% alpha; fragments 3x2 px at 18 px.
HEAVY HIT 4/6: ring 46 px at 35% alpha; star 12 px pale yellow; fragments 2x1 px at 22 px.
HEAVY HIT 5/6: star 6 px at 50% alpha; fragments are dots at 24 px at 30% alpha.
HEAVY HIT 6/6: only the faint ring at 12% alpha and two dots; centre empty.

groups.title_vi: Nháy ô khi va chạm
groups.anchor: fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: A whole-cell flash that lights the struck cell for one beat (impacts use one bright frame). Used when a locked attack lands on a cell and when a player strike hits. It is a soft square of light with a pixel-dithered edge, never solid.
groups.details_en: Square flash filling the cell, brightest at the centre and dithered toward the edges (2 px checker dither). 3 frames, plays once, 0.2 s. Must keep the chess square's pattern readable under it.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no fill that fully covers the square; no text.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 to white #ffffff only on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Nháy sáng cả ô trong 3 khung.

poses_en: CELL FLASH 1/3: the whole cell white at 80% alpha at the centre fading to 30% at the edges with checker dither.
CELL FLASH 2/3: cream at 50% alpha at the centre, edges 15%.
CELL FLASH 3/3: cream at 18% alpha at the centre, edges empty.

groups.title_vi: Vạch xung kích tỏa tròn
groups.anchor: centre at (24,24)
groups.subject_en: Short radial impact lines (comic-style) behind a big hit: boss phase hits, boss kill, Perfect Rub. Thin lines radiating from a hollow centre.
groups.details_en: 12 thin 1 px lines radiating from a 10 px hollow centre, each 6-10 px long. 3 frames, plays once. Never covers the actor's face.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no fill; no text.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 lines, white on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Các vạch nhỏ tỏa ra từ tâm.
groups.used_in: boss hits, boss kill, Perfect Rub

poses_en: LINES 1/3: 12 white lines 10 px long starting 5 px from the centre.
LINES 2/3: lines 8 px long, starting 9 px out, cream.
LINES 3/3: lines 5 px long starting 14 px out at 40% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Tia lửa 'keng' khi chém trúng giáp Xe sắt
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: The metallic clink when a strike hits the Iron Rook's front armor: the hit does no damage and the pawn recoils (req 21). It must read clearly as 'blocked', different from a normal hit spark: a short horizontal clink flash with cold-grey sparks.
groups.details_en: A bright horizontal slash-flash 20x4 px with a smaller vertical flash crossing it (a plus-shaped glint), and 4 small cold-grey/white sparks. 4 frames, plays once.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no yellow (that is the sword); no gore; no text.
groups.palette_en: Steel grey #aeb5bd and white #ffffff with pale blue #bfe3ff glints.
groups.notes_vi: Tia sáng xám lạnh hình dấu cộng, báo hiệu 'bị chặn', khác hẳn tia lửa đánh trúng.

poses_en: CLINK 1/4: a white plus-shaped glint: horizontal 22x4 px bar and vertical 4x14 px bar, nothing else.
CLINK 2/4: glint shrinks to 16 px wide; four steel-grey 2 px square sparks fly out diagonally at 8 px.
CLINK 3/4: glint 10 px wide at 60% alpha; sparks at 14 px, 1x1 px.
CLINK 4/4: a faint pale-blue dot at the centre at 30% alpha; two sparks at 18 px at 25% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Vệt đẩy lùi
groups.anchor: streak centre at (16,16); the piece moves toward the east
groups.subject_en: Speed streaks behind a piece shoved one cell (Black Pawn Captain shove, Lead Tip, Perfect Rub push-back). Drawn pointing east: the streaks trail from the west.
groups.details_en: Three tapered horizontal streaks of different lengths (y 9, 16, 23) trailing from x 2 to x 24, with small dust dots at their tails. 4 frames, plays once over the 1-cell push.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no actor art; no fill.
groups.palette_en: Pale cream #fff4d6 streaks with a warm-grey dust #c9bfae.
groups.notes_vi: Các vệt tốc độ ở phía sau khi quân bị đẩy 1 ô.
groups.used_in: B1 P2 shove, Lead Tip, Perfect Rub

poses_en: PUSH 1/4: three streaks at full length (22 px, 16 px, 12 px) at 85% alpha, dust dots at the tails.
PUSH 2/4: streaks shift 4 px east and shorten by 3 px, 65% alpha.
PUSH 3/4: streaks shorten to 10/8/6 px, 40% alpha, dust dots drift.
PUSH 4/4: two tiny streaks 4 px long at 20% alpha and three dust dots.

groups.title_vi: Sao nhỏ khi bước bị chặn (bump)
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), drawn at the edge between the pawn and the obstacle
groups.subject_en: A tiny tap-star when a step is blocked (the step_blocked event finally has a consumer): a bump, never silent.
groups.details_en: A 3-point tiny star (like a 'tap' mark) with two short motion ticks. 3 frames, plays once.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Warm grey #c9bfae and cream #fff4d6.
groups.notes_vi: Sao nhỏ khi pawn đụng vật cản.

poses_en: BUMP 1/3: a 10 px three-point cream star with two 3 px ticks on either side.
BUMP 2/3: star 7 px, ticks 2 px, 60% alpha.
BUMP 3/3: two dots at 30% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Mảnh sáp khi đánh bia bút sáp (T2)
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: Hit feedback for the harmless Crayon Target in T2 (HP 2, no attack). The target is a wax crayon drawing/target, so it sheds small wax crayon crumbs and a puff of colour dust, not chess-piece chips.
groups.details_en: A small burst: six wax crumbs (2x3 px) in mustard yellow, grass green and orange fly out, plus a 3-frame soft colour-dust puff. 5 frames, plays once. No blue crayon (blue is reserved for the child).
groups.avoid_en: No blue; no red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Mustard #e0b13b, grass green #6bb25a, orange #e0762a, cream dust #fff4d6.
groups.notes_vi: Mảnh sáp màu vàng, xanh lá, cam (không dùng xanh dương vì đó là màu của đứa trẻ).

poses_en: CRAYON 1/5: a cream flash 14 px with six wax crumbs just leaving the centre.
CRAYON 2/5: crumbs 8 px out, a soft dust puff 18 px at 50% alpha.
CRAYON 3/5: crumbs 12 px out; dust puff 22 px at 35% alpha.
CRAYON 4/5: crumbs 16 px out at 50% alpha; dust puff 24 px at 20% alpha.
CRAYON 5/5: two crumbs at 18 px at 25% alpha; empty centre.

groups.title_vi: Bụi bước chân: thảm cờ vua (vải)
groups.anchor: contact point at (12,14), between the pawn's feet
groups.subject_en: Step dust puff at the pawn's feet on a woven rug (step = tap SFX, dust puff, squash; at least three feedback channels at the first step). Small, quick, never covering the floor cell beneath for long.
groups.details_en: 3 particles' worth of puff: three small round puffs (the biggest 8 px) that rise 3 px and grow slightly before fading. 4 frames, plays once at 0.33 s, drawn at the contact point. Dithered 2-tone edge.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no smoke; no big clouds; no text.
groups.palette_en: Warm cloth fibre beige #d9c9a8 and pale grey #b9b2a3.
groups.notes_vi: Bụi sợi vải trên tấm thảm bàn cờ.

poses_en: STEP DUST 1/4: three tiny puffs 3-4 px at the centre, 80% alpha.
STEP DUST 2/4: puffs 5-6 px, spread 3 px apart, 65% alpha.
STEP DUST 3/4: puffs 7-8 px, risen 2 px, 40% alpha.
STEP DUST 4/4: puffs 8 px, risen 3 px, 15% alpha, nearly gone.

groups.subject_en: Step dust puff at the pawn's feet on a wooden floor or block surface (step = tap SFX, dust puff, squash; at least three feedback channels at the first step). Small, quick, never covering the floor cell beneath for long.
groups.details_en: 3 particles' worth of puff: three small round puffs (the biggest 8 px) that rise 3 px and grow slightly before fading. 4 frames, plays once at 0.33 s, drawn at the contact point. Dithered 2-tone edge.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no smoke; no big clouds; no text.
groups.palette_en: Light wood dust #d9b98a and warm grey #b9a98f.
groups.notes_vi: Bụi gỗ mịn.

groups.title_vi: Khói tà khí tan khỏi quân nhỏ
groups.anchor: base centre at (16,30), the same anchor as the piece it is drawn over
groups.subject_en: The menace lifting off a pawn-sized piece as it becomes an ordinary toy again: thin dark smoke wisps and the Black piece's dull-red magical seams (#9C2F2A) going out, rising and dissolving (the seams are decoration, used sparingly, here they DIE).
groups.details_en: 6 frames, plays once, drawn over the piece on the same 32x32 cell canvas, every wisp and seam inside the cell. The seams fade from the dull seam red #9C2F2A through a muddy brown-red #7A4A38 to dull wood brown before disappearing, so the last frames show a plain toy. The menace dying is not a threat: coral red #D84A3A (imminent damage only) and dark orange #E0762A (anticipation) are not used anywhere in this effect. No gore.
groups.avoid_en: No gore; no blood; no big explosion; no text; no coral red #D84A3A and no dark orange #E0762A (nothing here is about to hurt the pawn).
groups.palette_en: Charcoal smoke #2b303a at 50% alpha, seams dull seam red #9C2F2A fading through muddy brown-red #7A4A38 to wood brown #8a6a4a, a final pale ivory glint #fff4d6.
groups.notes_vi: Khói đen và các đường nứt đỏ tắt dần, quân trở lại thành đồ chơi bình thường.
groups.used_in: defeat clip of every Black piece

groups.title_vi: Vòng sáng boss hóa đồ chơi
groups.anchor: centre at (48,60)
groups.subject_en: The boss 'becomes a toy' transition (the first boss defeat and every later one): after maximum hit-stop a soft ring of warm light and paper stars sweeps outward across the piece while the music ducks. The message is relief and quiet, not an explosion.
groups.details_en: 8 frames, plays once. A flattened ring of warm ivory light expands from the piece's base to 90 px, carrying 8 tiny paper-star shapes; the ring is thin and calm. No smoke.
groups.avoid_en: No gore; no explosion; no red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Warm ivory #fff4d6, pale gold #fff2a8 and soft blue-white #dfeaff paper stars.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng sáng ấm lan ra, boss hóa thành đồ chơi trong yên lặng.

poses_en: TOY RING 1/8: a tiny bright ivory ring 14 px at the piece's base.
TOY RING 2/8: ring 28 px, four paper stars 3 px at the ring.
TOY RING 3/8: ring 44 px, stars 4 px, 90% alpha.
TOY RING 4/8: ring 60 px, eight stars 5 px.
TOY RING 5/8: ring 74 px at 70% alpha, stars drifting upward.
TOY RING 6/8: ring 84 px at 45% alpha, stars 5 px.
TOY RING 7/8: ring 90 px at 22% alpha, three stars.
TOY RING 8/8: ring gone, two stars at 15% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Dấu choáng (stagger)
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), floats above the piece head
groups.subject_en: A small cue above an enemy during its 0.35 s hit stagger (no new telegraph can start): three tiny pencil tick marks spinning like a little crown.
groups.details_en: Three 2x4 px pencil ticks around a small ring, 2 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Pale cream #fff4d6 ticks with a neutral graphite #6B7380 shadow.
groups.notes_vi: Ba nét chì nhỏ xoay trên đầu quân bị choáng.

poses_en: STAGGER 1/2: three ticks at 12, 4 and 8 o'clock around a 6 px ring.
STAGGER 2/2: the ticks rotated 30 degrees clockwise.

groups.title_vi: Dấu 'chiếu' (In Check) trên kẻ địch
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), floats above the piece head
groups.subject_en: The In Check marker set on an attacker by a Perfect Rub: it cannot telegraph or attack for 0.8 s. A tiny hand-drawn pencil circle with a diagonal slash and a small crown tick (a chess 'check' motif without text).
groups.details_en: A 10 px pencil ring with a short diagonal slash across it and a tiny 3 px crown tick on top. 2 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no letters or '+' text.
groups.palette_en: Graphite grey #6b7380 with a pale-blue #bfe3ff highlight.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng chì có gạch chéo, nhắc đến 'chiếu' trong cờ vua.

poses_en: IN CHECK 1/2: ring and slash at full strength, crown tick up.
IN CHECK 2/2: ring pulses 1 px bigger, crown tick 1 px lower.

groups.title_vi: Dấu choáng nặng (Xe bị stun)
groups.anchor: centre at (16,8), above the Rook's head
groups.subject_en: Stun cue for the Rook after hitting a blocker (3 s in the Rook Warden's throne smash): little swirl stars orbiting like toy 'dizzy' marks.
groups.details_en: Three small cream stars (4-point, 4 px) orbiting an ellipse 24x8 px. 4 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 and pale gold #fff2a8 stars.
groups.notes_vi: Ba ngôi sao nhỏ xoay quanh đầu Xe khi bị choáng.

poses_en: STUN 1/4: stars at the left, right and centre-back of the ellipse.
STUN 2/4: stars moved a quarter turn clockwise.
STUN 3/4: stars moved a half turn.
STUN 4/4: stars moved three quarters of a turn.

groups.title_vi: Vòng 'cắm rễ' khi giữ Eraser Guard
groups.anchor: ring centre at (16,20), under the pawn's base
groups.subject_en: A soft rubber ring under the pawn while Eraser Guard is held ('the pawn is planted'): it shows the guard is up and the pawn cannot step. The ring has a notch pointing to the guarded side (east).
groups.details_en: An ellipse ring 26x12 px, 2 px thick, with a small notch marker at the east and tiny eraser dots. 2 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Soft eraser pink-white #f3e1e1 with a pale blue #bfe3ff inner line.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng cao su mềm dưới chân khi giữ Guard, có mấu chỉ hướng đỡ đòn.

poses_en: PLANTED 1/2: ring at full strength, notch bright.
PLANTED 2/2: ring 1 px wider, notch dimmer (slow breathing).

groups.title_vi: Dấu hở sườn sau khi ra đòn
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), above the piece
groups.subject_en: A tiny downward chevron pair above an enemy during its recovery window (the Knight after landing, the Rook after a stun): a calm 'now' cue, not a prompt.
groups.details_en: Two stacked 8 px downward chevrons in cream. 2 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text; no arrows that look like damage.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6 with a mint #63d68b centre dot.
groups.notes_vi: Hai chữ V nhỏ báo thời điểm có thể đánh.

poses_en: VULNERABLE 1/2: chevrons at rest.
VULNERABLE 2/2: chevrons 1 px lower.

groups.title_vi: Nhãn 'bị cắt' trên nút Chalk (Hậu phá)

groups.subject_en: A torn-paper sticker over the child's call slot while help is disrupted (Queen's Tear the Drawing, King's Close the Box): the crayon marks go grey and a ragged paper tape crosses them.
groups.details_en: A ragged diagonal torn-paper strip crossing the slot with two grey scribble lines. 2 frames loop (the strip trembles).
groups.avoid_en: No red; no letters.
groups.palette_en: Paper white #f2ebdc strip, grey pencil #9A9AA3 scribble (the enemy amendment ink).
groups.notes_vi: Mảnh giấy rách chéo khi sự giúp đỡ bị chặn.

poses_en: DISRUPTED 1/2: strip at its rest angle, scribbles at full strength.
DISRUPTED 2/2: strip rotated 4 degrees, one scribble line shorter.

groups.anchor: centre at (16,20), under the item
groups.subject_en: A soft gold halo under a pickup (sword, pencil, floor weapon, grant markers). The old red pickup glow of the prototype is replaced with gold-ivory, never red. It must be visible at gameplay zoom without looking like a warning.

It is drawn in the cell directly in front of the pawn, pointing east, and is the quick slash that makes the sword silhouette unique against the Pencil's long thrust and the Ruler's wide sweep.

Two or three tiny 2 px square fragments follow the arc. 5 frames, plays once at 24 fps. The arc is brightest on the impact frame (frame 2). It stays inside the 32x32 cell.

Look: a graphite-gray shaft, a pale-blue speed line and a sharp two-cell impact. The effect is split into two files (near, far) so the engine lays the two cells and the artist draws one thing at a time.

The shaft's right edge and the speed lines must meet the far-cell shaft at the same rows (y 12 to 20 for the shaft).

groups.details_en: A grey smudge line along the thrust lane with a few graphite specks. 4 frames, plays once; never darker than 35% alpha.

SMEAR 2/4: smudge 25% alpha, specks drifting.
SMEAR 3/4: smudge 14% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Ô ma báo điểm đáp Rule Step (chữ L)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: Ghost marks showing the two forward L cells for Rule Step (2 ahead, 1 left or right; tap left/right within 0.15 s to choose). VALID = a soft ivory/pale-blue ghost outline with a small pawn-base silhouette; CHOSEN = the same, brighter with a tiny crayon-blue arrow; INVALID = the landing cell is inside a currently locked telegraph, so the ghost turns coral red and the pawn would be hit on touchdown (red is allowed here because it IS imminent damage), with an X pattern so colour is never the only cue. HC clips add cream + charcoal keylines.
groups.details_en: Each clip is a 3-frame loop at 6 fps. VALID: 1 px dotted pale-blue outline inset 2 px, a faint 10 px pawn-base silhouette at the centre at 45% alpha. CHOSEN: 2 px solid ivory outline, silhouette at 75% alpha, a 5 px blue arrow tick pointing toward the cell. INVALID: 2 px coral outline, a coral-hatched fill at 30% alpha and a bold X across the cell.
groups.avoid_en: No red in VALID or CHOSEN; no text; no actor art; no bloom.
groups.palette_en: Ivory #fff4d6, pale blue #bfe3ff, crayon blue #4da3ff tick (CHOSEN only), coral #d84a3a (INVALID only), HC keylines cream #fff4d6 and charcoal #1e2229.
groups.notes_vi: Ô ma hiển thị 2 ô L; ô đỏ + dấu X nghĩa là đáp vào vùng nguy hiểm. Các clip _hc (tương phản cao) hạ xuống 'could': công cụ có thể sinh từ bản thường (viền kem + viền than + hoa văn dày hơn), chỉ vẽ tay nếu bản sinh ra chưa ổn.

INVALID 2/3: hatch scrolled 2 px, X 85%.
INVALID 3/3: hatch scrolled 4 px, X 70%; loops to frame 1.

HC VALID 2/3: dots marched one step.
HC VALID 3/3: dots marched again; loops.
HC CHOSEN 1/3: cream and charcoal keylines around a solid ivory 3 px outline, bold blue arrow.
HC CHOSEN 2/3: outline 90%.
HC CHOSEN 3/3: outline 80%; loops.
HC INVALID 1/3: cream and charcoal keylines around a 3 px coral outline, 2 px hatch, 3 px bold X.
HC INVALID 2/3: hatch scrolled 2 px.
HC INVALID 3/3: hatch scrolled 4 px; loops to frame 1.

groups.palette_en: Pale blue #bfe3ff and ivory #fff4d6 lines at 70% alpha, paper white bits.
groups.notes_vi: Ba vệt cong xanh nhạt khi pawn nhảy qua.

FLIGHT 2/4: lines lengthen to 22, 16, 12 px across the cell, two paper bits.

FLIGHT 4/4: lines gone but two paper bits at 20% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Bóng pawn trên mặt đất khi bay
groups.anchor: shadow centre at (16,8); the engine slides it along the L path on the ground
groups.subject_en: The ground shadow of the pawn during the 0.22 s flight (the pawn is lifted and untargetable; its shadow stays on the grid so the landing cell is readable). It echoes the Knight's shadow in a smaller, ivory-friendly way.
groups.details_en: A soft dark oval that is smallest at mid-flight and largest at takeoff/landing. 4 frames, plays once at 18 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no outline; no text.
groups.palette_en: Charcoal #1e2229 at 25% to 40% alpha.
groups.notes_vi: Bóng nhỏ trên sàn trong lúc bay.

poses_en: SHADOW 1/4: oval 16x7 px at 40% alpha (still near the ground).
SHADOW 2/4: oval 11x5 px at 28% alpha (rising).
SHADOW 3/4: oval 10x5 px at 25% alpha (apex).
SHADOW 4/4: oval 17x7 px at 42% alpha (descending).

groups.title_vi: Bóng mờ pawn khi bay (bất khả xâm)
groups.anchor: feet centre at (16,30), the same anchor as every chess piece
groups.subject_en: A pale after-image ghost left behind as the pawn leaves the ground (it is untargetable in flight). A translucent pawn silhouette (round base, neck, round head) with no face, in cool blue-white, that dissolves. This is the visual language for 'untargetable' (Status.untargetable_left).
groups.details_en: A pawn-shaped ghost 18x22 px made of pale blue-white at decreasing alpha, with a dithered edge. 4 frames, plays once at 16 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is reserved for danger); no text; no actor art; no bloom blur; must not hide the enemy.
groups.palette_en: Pale blue-white #dfeaff at 50% alpha down to 10%.
groups.notes_vi: Bóng ma xanh trắng của pawn, tan nhanh.

poses_en: AFTERIMAGE 1/4: the ghost at 50% alpha exactly at the takeoff pose.
AFTERIMAGE 2/4: ghost 35% alpha, 2 px higher.
AFTERIMAGE 3/4: ghost 20% alpha, 4 px higher, edges dithering away.
AFTERIMAGE 4/4: a faint 10% alpha outline only.

groups.title_vi: Vòng báo có thể Rule Step lần 2 (trang Knight Errant)
groups.anchor: ring centre at (16,20), around the pawn's feet
groups.subject_en: A small cue that the Knight Errant page's second Rule Step is available within 1.0 s: a ring of tiny blue knight-hoof ticks closing like a countdown. Pawn-owned, so ivory and pale blue, not child blue.
groups.details_en: An ellipse ring 24x12 px with six ticks; the ring shrinks over 4 frames (one second total). Plays once, 4 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Ivory #fff4d6, pale blue #bfe3ff.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng nhỏ co lại báo còn 1 giây để Rule Step lần hai.

poses_en: READY 1/4: ring 24x12 px, six ticks, 100%.
READY 2/4: ring 20x10 px, five ticks.
READY 3/4: ring 16x8 px, three ticks at 70%.
READY 4/4: ring 12x6 px, one tick at 40%.

groups.title_vi: Báo Tốt Xung Phong đã nạp: bụi tụ quanh chân (vòng lặp)
groups.anchor: feet-anchored: the pawn's base-bottom centre is at (16,30); the ring lies on the floor around the base (ring centre (16,26)) and never covers the pawn's face
groups.subject_en: The hero's Charging Pawn Page 'armed' cue. The Page (margin cost 1) rewrites the pawn's step: after standing still for 1.0 s, the next step becomes a two-cell double step. Without a cue the player cannot tell when the double step is available. While it is armed, a ring of short ivory dust-lines gathers around the pawn's base on the floor and draws slowly inward, like a held breath before a sprint. Pawn-owned: ivory, warm dust beige and a little neutral graphite only.
groups.details_en: Eight short dashes (each 6 px long and 2 px thick) lie on a flat ellipse around the base (radii 13 px east-west and 5 px north-south around the centre (16,26), matching the 65-degree view, so the whole ring fits the 32x32 cell) and drift inward as the loop plays, so the eye reads 'gathering'. Four frames loop at 6 fps (0.67 s per cycle); frame 4 leads into frame 1 with no jump, because the dashes that vanish into the base at the end of a cycle reappear on the outer ring at the start of the next. Each dash is one flat translucent fill at the alpha written for it. Dashes on the near (south) half are horizontal ticks, those on the far (north) half are shorter. Nothing is drawn on the pawn's body.
groups.avoid_en: No blue of any kind (blue belongs to the child), no red or coral (red is danger), no glow or bloom, no rim light, no sparks or stars, no arrows, no text, no pawn body or face drawn (the pawn is a separate sprite), nothing covering the pawn's face or the cell it stands on.
groups.palette_en: ivory dust-line #F1E8D2, warm dust beige #D9CCAE, neutral graphite specks #6B7380 (two at most). No blue and no red of any kind.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng bụi ngà tụ vào chân pawn, báo là bước kép (double step) của trang Tốt Xung Phong đã sẵn sàng. Không dùng xanh, không dùng đỏ.
groups.used_in: Charging Pawn page, hero (tb2, bs3 onward)

poses_en: ARMED 1/4: eight ivory dashes on the outer ring (radii 13 x 5 px), evenly spaced, each pointing toward the base, 45% alpha; two graphite specks at 40% alpha near the floor.
ARMED 2/4: the dashes drawn 3 px inward (radii 10 x 4 px) and a hair longer (8 px), 65% alpha; one graphite speck.
ARMED 3/4: the dashes at radii 7 x 3 px, 85% alpha, the brightest frame of the loop; two beige dust crumbs lift 2 px beside the base.
ARMED 4/4: the dashes shrunk to 4 px and almost touching the base rim (radii 4 x 2 px), 50% alpha, fading out; the next cycle's outer ring is NOT drawn here (frame 1 supplies it).

groups.title_vi: Khoảnh khắc nạp xong của Tốt Xung Phong (một lần)
groups.anchor: feet-anchored: the pawn's base-bottom centre is at (16,30); the effect lies on the floor around the base (centre (16,26))
groups.subject_en: The moment the Charging Pawn Page becomes armed: the pawn has stood still for exactly 1.0 s. The dust-lines snap inward in one beat and a thin ivory ring pulses once at the base, then the looping armed cue (a separate effect) takes over. It tells the player 'now' instead of letting the loop simply appear. Pawn-owned: ivory, dust beige and graphite only.
groups.details_en: Four frames, plays once at 14 fps (0.29 s). Frame 1 is one beat of anticipation (the dashes pull OUT), frame 2 is the single brightest frame, frames 3-4 settle into the ring that the loop starts from. Dashes are 2 px thick flat fills; the ring is a 2 px line. Nothing is drawn on the pawn's body.
groups.avoid_en: No blue of any kind (blue belongs to the child), no red or coral (red is danger), no glow or bloom, no rim light, no sparks or stars, no arrows, no text, no pawn body or face drawn (the pawn is a separate sprite), nothing covering the pawn's face or the cell it stands on.
groups.palette_en: ivory dust-line #F1E8D2, warm dust beige #D9CCAE, neutral graphite specks #6B7380 (two at most). No blue and no red of any kind.
groups.notes_vi: Nhịp 'đã nạp' một lần khi pawn đứng yên đủ 1,0 giây, rồi vòng lặp charging_armed_cue tiếp nối.

poses_en: SNAP 1/4: eight faint ivory dashes pulled OUT to radii 15 x 6 px, 30% alpha, one frame of anticipation.
SNAP 2/4: the dashes slam to radii 5 x 2 px stretched to 8 px long, 95% alpha (the brightest frame), a 2 px ivory ring flash at the base contact point.
SNAP 3/4: a thin ivory ring 20 x 8 px around the base at 70% alpha, the dashes gone, two dust crumbs lifted 3 px.
SNAP 4/4: the ring expands to 28 x 10 px at 20% alpha, one crumb left at 20% alpha; the looping armed cue takes over.

groups.title_vi: Vệt bước kép của Tốt Xung Phong (hai ô)
groups.anchor: two cells wide: the streak axis runs along y=16 from the origin cell centre at (16,16) to the destination cell centre at (48,16); drawn pointing EAST (the engine rotates or flips it); the pawn's own slide is code, this file is only the lines
groups.subject_en: The hero's double step from the Charging Pawn Page: two cells in one step, a sprint from a standing start. A two-cell streak of ivory speed-lines along the floor from the origin cell to the destination cell, with a kick of dust at the origin. The landing dust is the district's own step dust (separate files); this is only the motion. Pawn-owned: ivory and dust beige.
groups.details_en: 64x32 = two cells, east-facing. Four frames, plays once at 20 fps (0.2 s, about the length of one ordinary step). The burst starts dense in the west cell, stretches across both cells and thins out in the east cell. Lines are 2 px thick flat fills with the alpha written for each frame; the dust puff is at the origin only. The lines thin out before the centre of the east cell so the landing cell stays readable.
groups.avoid_en: No blue of any kind (blue belongs to the child), no red or coral (red is danger), no glow or bloom, no rim light, no sparks or stars, no arrows, no text, no pawn body or face drawn (the pawn is a separate sprite), nothing covering the pawn's face or the cell it stands on.
groups.palette_en: ivory speed-lines #F1E8D2, warm dust beige #D9CCAE for the origin puff. No blue and no red of any kind.
groups.notes_vi: Vệt 2 ô khi pawn lướt bước kép: các vạch ngà chạy từ ô đầu sang ô sau, bụi bật ra ở ô đầu. Vẽ quay mặt về hướng ĐÔNG.
groups.used_in: Charging Pawn page, hero double step

poses_en: DASH 1/4: five ivory speed-lines 14, 12, 10, 8 and 6 px long in the west cell (x 4-30), the longest on the centre row, 90% alpha; a beige dust puff 10 px wide kicked backwards at the origin (16,24).
DASH 2/4: the lines stretched to 26, 22, 18, 14 and 10 px, spanning x 12-44 across the border of the two cells, 80% alpha; the origin puff 14 px at 60% alpha.

DASH 4/4: three short 6 px lines left at the east edge, 25% alpha; the origin puff 16 px at 10% alpha, nearly gone.

groups.subject_en: Spark when the guard negates a LINE attack through the guarded side (Rook charge, pencil poke, straight beam): rubber crumbs and a graphite smudge puff, soft and absorbing, not metallic (different from the Iron Rook clink).
groups.details_en: A soft white-pink puff with five eraser crumbs and a grey graphite smudge burst, facing east. 4 frames, plays once at 16 fps.

groups.notes_vi: Bụi tẩy hồng-trắng và vệt chì khi đỡ được đòn.

BLOCK 2/4: five eraser crumbs fly out 8 px, a graphite smudge puff 12 px.
BLOCK 3/4: crumbs 14 px out, smudge 16 px at 50%.

groups.title_vi: Flash Perfect Rub (đỡ đúng 0.25 s đầu)
groups.anchor: centre at (24,24), on the guarded side of the pawn
groups.subject_en: The Perfect Rub: a line attack lands within the first 0.25 s after the guard is up. The attacker is put In Check, pushed back 1 cell, and the pawn gains +1 Believe. A bright, satisfying cream-and-pink burst with eraser crumbs and a pale-blue ring (the Believe tick). The one guard feedback that must feel great.
groups.details_en: A white starburst, a pink-white ring expanding to 44 px, ten eraser crumbs and a small blue crayon tick appearing at the end (Believe gained). 6 frames, plays once at 14 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6, pink-white #f3e1e1, pale blue #bfe3ff and crayon blue #4da3ff tick, white only on frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Nổ sáng kem-hồng kèm dấu tick xanh (Believe +1).

poses_en: PERFECT RUB 1/6: a white 12-point starburst 30 px.
PERFECT RUB 2/6: starburst 22 px cream, a ring 24 px, six crumbs.
PERFECT RUB 3/6: ring 34 px at 70%, ten crumbs 14 px out.
PERFECT RUB 4/6: ring 42 px at 45%, crumbs 20 px out, a blue crayon tick draws in at the upper right.
PERFECT RUB 5/6: ring 46 px at 25%, the blue tick at full strength.
