groups.details_en: Four eraser crumbs falling and bouncing once. 4 frames, plays once.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Pink-white #f3e1e1, graphite #6B7380.
groups.notes_vi: Vài vụn tẩy rơi báo hết lượt Guard.

poses_en: CRUMBS 1/4: four crumbs just leaving the pad's position.
CRUMBS 2/4: crumbs 4 px lower.
CRUMBS 3/4: crumbs touching the floor, one bouncing 2 px.
CRUMBS 4/4: crumbs at rest at 40% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Vụn tẩy khi chà Rule Mark
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: The crumbs of the eraser rub: while the pawn holds the guard on a Rule Mark (the forced use at bt4, bto, ub1) pink eraser crumbs and specks of graphite dust lift off the mark. Effect only: the Rule Mark prop and its rub, erased and restore frames are drawn as separate floor-prop files; this overlay never draws the mark or the eraser.
groups.details_en: Crumbs: pink and grey specks, 2 px square and 4 px by 2 px, on a transparent canvas, centred on the cell, drifting up and falling. The clip loops while the guard is held.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text; the glyph itself is not drawn here.
groups.palette_en: Pink-white #f3e1e1, graphite #6B7380, printed ink #3b3a4a at 50% alpha.
groups.notes_vi: Chà xóa Rule Mark: 3 clip chà, đã xóa, quay lại sau 6 giây.

poses_en: Two pink eraser crumbs and one speck of graphite dust at the centre of the cell.
Four crumbs rising and drifting left, two specks of graphite.
Five crumbs and three graphite specks spread about 14 px wide.
The crumbs falling back down, the last two fading; loops to frame 1.

groups.title_vi: Ô chéo viền sáp (tập Free Step)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: The practice diagonal cell outlined in crayon at the start of Black King phase 4 (10 s zero-damage rehearsal): shows where the first diagonal will land. Child-like crayon outline on the cell (the pawn's unlock ink is blue crayon), a soft pulse, and a small diagonal arrow tick. A prompt widget shows the keys separately.
groups.details_en: A hand-drawn crayon square outline (3 px thick, wobbly) around the cell, a small NE diagonal arrow tick at the centre and four tiny blue dots at the corners. 4 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff outline, pale #bfe3ff highlight, mint #63d68b dot at the centre (safe).
groups.notes_vi: Ô chéo được viền bằng sáp xanh để tập.

poses_en: PRACTICE CELL 1/4: outline at full strength, arrow tick, corner dots bright.
PRACTICE CELL 2/4: outline 90%, dots dimmer, arrow tick 1 px NE.
PRACTICE CELL 3/4: outline 80%, dots dim, arrow tick 2 px NE.
PRACTICE CELL 4/4: outline 90%, arrow tick back; loops.

groups.title_vi: Ô chéo duy nhất còn mở (P4)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: The one open diagonal cell in Black King phase 4, after the rewritten tiles cover every cardinal approach. Safe (mint) and hand-drawn (crayon): the first diagonal the player ever makes. Quiet, never celebratory before the step.
groups.details_en: A mint soft square glow with a crayon-blue broken outline (dashed) and a tiny NE arrow made of two pencil-like strokes. 4 frames loop.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Mint #63d68b glow at 35%, crayon blue #4da3ff dashed outline, cream core.
groups.notes_vi: Ô chéo an toàn màu bạc hà viền sáp xanh nét đứt.

poses_en: OPEN CELL 1/4: mint glow 35%, dashed outline at full strength.
OPEN CELL 2/4: glow 42%, dashes marched one step.
OPEN CELL 3/4: glow 50%, dashes marched again.
OPEN CELL 4/4: glow 42%; loops.

groups.title_vi: Xé luật: vết rách chéo khi bước chéo đầu tiên
groups.anchor: centre at (24,24), placed at the shared corner between the two diagonal cells
groups.subject_en: The rule tear on the pawn's FIRST diagonal step (the peak of the game; rare, dramatic rule-tear motion). A ripped page of the Book opens along the diagonal where the rule 'a pawn never moves diagonally' was written: ragged paper lips with a line of gold-white light spilling out and torn printed-ink fragments flying. Dramatic but brief, then clean.
groups.details_en: A diagonal tear from the bottom-left to the top-right: ragged white paper lips with tiny printed ink dashes on them, a pale-gold light inside the gap, six ink-dash fragments and paper bits. 8 frames, plays once at 14 fps; the tear opens (frames 1-4) and heals into soft sparkles (5-8).
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text letters (ink marks are abstract dashes); no screen flash; no gore.
groups.palette_en: Paper white #f2ebdc lips, ink #3b3a4a dashes, pale gold light #fff2a8, white #ffffff on frame 3.
groups.notes_vi: Vết rách giấy chéo với ánh vàng bên trong, mảnh mực bay ra rồi lành thành lấp lánh.
groups.used_in: ubb P4 first diagonal and later Free Step

poses_en: RULE TEAR 1/8: a hairline crack along the diagonal, 40 px long, 2 px wide, pale gold inside.
RULE TEAR 2/8: the crack opens to 6 px wide, ragged paper lips visible, two ink dashes.
RULE TEAR 3/8: wide open 10 px, white-hot gold light inside, six ink dashes and paper bits flying.
RULE TEAR 4/8: the tear at its widest 12 px, fragments 14 px out, light dimming to pale gold.
RULE TEAR 5/8: the lips begin to close, 8 px wide, fragments 20 px out.
RULE TEAR 6/8: closing to 4 px, fragments fading, sparkles appear along the line.
RULE TEAR 7/8: a thin 2 px seam with gold sparkles, three fragments at 25%.
RULE TEAR 8/8: only five gold sparkles at 15% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Vệt bước chéo
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); drawn pointing NORTH-EAST for the upper-right cell; the engine flips/rotates for the other diagonal cells
groups.subject_en: Motion streak along the diagonal cell-to-cell step of Free Step (0.18 s, the same reserve-then-commit protocol). Long crisp diagonal lines (this is the pawn's own freedom, sharp and clean) with a few gold specks.
groups.details_en: Three diagonal lines pointing NE of different lengths and two gold specks. 4 frames, plays once at 18 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is reserved for danger); no text; no actor art; no bloom blur; must not hide the enemy.
groups.palette_en: Ivory #fff4d6 lines, pale gold #fff2a8 specks.
groups.notes_vi: Ba vệt chéo sắc nét và vài hạt vàng.

poses_en: DIAGONAL 1/4: three lines 12, 9 and 7 px at the bottom-left, 90% alpha.
DIAGONAL 2/4: lines lengthen to 22, 16, 11 px across the cell, two gold specks.
DIAGONAL 3/4: lines at the top-right, 70% alpha.
DIAGONAL 4/4: faint lines 6 px at 25% alpha, one speck.

groups.title_vi: Bung sáng khi đáp bước chéo
groups.anchor: burst centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: The landing burst at the end of a Free Step: a ring of gold sparkles with torn-paper bits, clean and joyful (the courage to disobey now belongs to the pawn). Smaller than the rule tear.
groups.details_en: A cream ring expanding to 28 px with eight gold sparkles and four paper bits. 5 frames, plays once at 14 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Pale gold #fff2a8, cream #fff4d6, paper white #f2ebdc.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng lấp lánh vàng khi đáp xuống ô chéo.

poses_en: LAND 1/5: a white 10 px flash.
LAND 2/5: ring 14 px, four sparkles.
LAND 3/5: ring 22 px, eight sparkles 4 px, paper bits.
LAND 4/5: ring 28 px at 50%, sparkles 14 px out.
LAND 5/5: ring faded, three sparkles at 20%.

groups.title_vi: Hiệu ứng 'không được' khi bấm chéo (head-shake)
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), above the pawn's head
groups.subject_en: The foreshadowing denial: when the player first presses a diagonal chord before Free Step is owned, the pawn head-shakes and a Book margin note is written. This tiny effect sits above the pawn's head: three grey pencil 'no' ticks wobbling left and right. Never red, never scolding; the pawn is merely told 'a pawn captures diagonally; it never steps'.
groups.details_en: Three short grey pencil ticks (1x4 px) around a small puff, wobbling horizontally. 4 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text; no X cross.
groups.palette_en: Graphite grey #6B7380, cream puff #fff4d6.
groups.notes_vi: Ba nét chì xám lắc ngang trên đầu pawn khi bấm chéo mà chưa có Free Step.

poses_en: DENIED 1/4: a small puff 6 px with three ticks vertical.
DENIED 2/4: ticks tilted 15 degrees left, puff 8 px.
DENIED 3/4: ticks tilted 15 degrees right, puff 9 px.
DENIED 4/4: ticks back to vertical at 40% alpha, puff 10 px at 25%.

groups.title_vi: In Passing: dấu cửa sổ 0,45 giây trên ô kẻ địch vừa lướt qua
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16): the cell the enemy just crossed, beside the pawn; the art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: In Passing (deferred extension E1): when an enemy finishes a move of two or more cells beside the pawn, the cell it crossed becomes a Strike target for 0.45 s. This is that window marker: four corner ticks and a ring that closes like a short clock, so the player can see how long the chance lasts. Pawn-owned: ivory and pale blue-white, not crayon blue.
groups.details_en: Four ivory corner ticks (4 px arms, 2 px thick) frame the cell. A ring starts at 24 px and shrinks to 8 px over 5 frames at 11 fps (0.45 s), opening gaps as it goes, so the player reads 'now ... now ... gone'. Plays once. The ring is a 2 px line drawn as a flat translucent fill; the centre of the cell stays clear so the enemy underneath stays readable.
groups.avoid_en: No crayon blue (blue belongs to the child), no red or coral (red is danger), no glow or bloom, no text, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks or the enemy standing in it.
groups.palette_en: ivory #FFF4D6, pale blue-white #DFEAFF, neutral dust grey #B9A98F
groups.notes_vi: Khung + vòng đồng hồ co dần trong 0,45 giây trên ô kẻ địch vừa lướt qua cạnh pawn. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: WINDOW 1/5: four ivory corner ticks and a complete 24 px ring, 90% alpha.
WINDOW 2/5: the ring 20 px, the corner ticks pulled 1 px in, 85% alpha.
WINDOW 3/5: the ring 16 px with a 2 px gap opening on its north side, 80% alpha.
WINDOW 4/5: the ring 12 px with gaps on its north and south, 65% alpha, the ticks 2 px in.
WINDOW 5/5: the ring 8 px broken into four short arcs at 35% alpha, the ticks nearly touching: the window is about to close.

groups.title_vi: In Passing: vệt kéo kẻ địch lùi về ô vừa lướt qua
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); drawn pointing EAST (the direction of the drag); the engine places one per dragged cell and rotates it
groups.subject_en: In Passing (deferred extension E1): the Strike hooks the passing enemy and drags it back to the crossed cell. This is the trail left in ONE dragged cell: ivory speed-lines behind a smeared scuff of the enemy's base and a few torn paper bits.
groups.details_en: Three ivory lines of different lengths and a dust-grey scuff smear, drawn pointing east. 4 frames, plays once at 16 fps. The scuff is a neutral dust grey, never graphite or grey pencil (grey pencil is only the ink of an enemy rule).
groups.avoid_en: No crayon blue (blue belongs to the child), no red or coral (red is danger), no glow or bloom, no text, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks or the enemy standing in it.
groups.palette_en: ivory #FFF4D6, pale blue-white #DFEAFF, neutral dust grey #B9A98F, paper bits #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Vệt kéo lùi trong một ô: vạch ngà, vệt trượt đế quân địch, vài mảnh giấy. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: DRAG 1/4: three ivory lines 10, 8 and 6 px long trailing behind (west of) a faint scuff mark at (22,20), 80% alpha; one paper bit.
DRAG 2/4: the lines stretched to 22, 16 and 12 px across the whole cell, the scuff smeared into a 16 px dust-grey streak at 40% alpha, two paper bits.
DRAG 3/4: the lines on the east half, 18 px, thinning, 55% alpha; the streak 24 px at 30% alpha.
DRAG 4/4: a faint 10 px streak at 15% alpha and one paper bit at 20% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Ruler Gate: dấu neo bằng sáp xanh trên ô gọi được
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); a flat decal that fills its cell
groups.subject_en: Ruler Gate (deferred extension E2, the child's call): the room marks the cell where the child can hold a shortcut open (the InterventionAnchor). A faint crayon-blue pin-cross drawn on the floor tells the player where the call works. Child-made, so crayon blue.
groups.details_en: A 12 px wobbly crayon-blue cross inside a loose 20 px circle, both about 3 px thick like wax, at 55% alpha. 2 frames loop at 3 fps, the second frame a hair brighter (65% alpha) with the cross shifted 1 px. Very quiet: this is always on screen in its room.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: crayon blue #3A6FE0 (lit variant #4DA3FF), chalk white #EAF0FA, paper dust #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Dấu thập xanh sáp mờ trên ô neo của cổng thước. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).
groups.used_in: Ruler Gate (E2), rooms with an anchor

poses_en: ANCHOR 1/2: the wobbly cross and circle at 55% alpha.
ANCHOR 2/2: the same marks at 65% alpha, the cross shifted 1 px right.

groups.title_vi: Ruler Gate: thước ép xuống ô neo
groups.anchor: anchor cell centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: Ruler Gate (deferred extension E2, the child's call): the child's hand lays a wooden ruler on the anchor cell and presses it down to hold a shortcut open. This is the press: the end of a boxwood ruler drops onto the anchor, squashes, and a ring of paper dust settles. Child motion is slower and heavier than the pawn's. The ruler gate prop and the hand are separate files.
groups.details_en: Draws only the pressing end of the ruler (a 10 px wide boxwood slab with three plain tick marks, no numerals) entering from above, a crayon-blue anchor cross under it and the dust ring. 5 frames, plays once at 12 fps. Frame 5 is the resting state: the ruler flat on the anchor, the blue ring 24 px at 50% alpha, the anchor cross at full strength.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: boxwood #E4C77A (shade #C9A24B), tick black #2B2B2B, crayon blue #3A6FE0 (lit variant #4DA3FF), chalk white #EAF0FA, paper dust #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Thước đặt xuống và ép ô neo, bụi giấy bung ra. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: PRESS 1/5: the ruler's end 14 px above the cell centre, tilted 6 degrees, three tick marks, no dust yet.
PRESS 2/5: the ruler's end touches the cell centre, flat, a 1 px darker shadow under it; a crayon-blue anchor cross 10 px appears under it at 60% alpha.
PRESS 3/5: the ruler pressed 2 px lower (a small squash), a ring of paper dust 20 px wide at 70% alpha, the blue cross at full strength.
PRESS 4/5: the dust ring 28 px at 40% alpha with three paper scraps, the ruler settled and still.

PRESS 5/5: the dust gone but two scraps at 20% alpha; the ruler resting flat on the anchor, with the blue ring 24 px at 50% alpha around it and the anchor cross at full strength (the start of the hold loop).

groups.title_vi: Ruler Gate: thước giữ cổng mở (vòng lặp)
groups.anchor: anchor cell centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: Ruler Gate (deferred extension E2, the child's call): the hold. The ruler stays pressed on the anchor cell while the gate is held open; a ring of crayon-blue chalk breathes slowly around it to show the hold is active and costing the child something.
groups.details_en: The ruler resting flat on the anchor, as at the end of the press (the boxwood ruler end flat on the anchor cross), with a 26 px crayon-blue ring that swells and relaxes. 4 frames loop at 6 fps, frame 4 leading back into frame 1.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: boxwood #E4C77A (shade #C9A24B), tick black #2B2B2B, crayon blue #3A6FE0 (lit variant #4DA3FF), chalk white #EAF0FA, paper dust #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Thước nằm yên trên ô neo, vòng phấn xanh thở chậm. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: HOLD 1/4: the ruler resting flat, the blue ring 24 px at 50% alpha, the anchor cross at full strength.
HOLD 2/4: the ring 26 px at 60% alpha.
HOLD 3/4: the ring 28 px at 55% alpha, one chalk speck above it.
HOLD 4/4: the ring 26 px at 50% alpha, leading back to frame 1.

groups.title_vi: Ruler Gate: thước nhấc ra, cổng khép lại
groups.anchor: anchor cell centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: Ruler Gate (deferred extension E2, the child's call): the release. The hold ends, the ruler lifts off the anchor and the blue ring and cross fade out, so the player sees the shortcut is about to close.
groups.details_en: The ruler lifts straight up out of the cell while the ring shrinks and the cross fades; a few paper scraps drift. 4 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: boxwood #E4C77A (shade #C9A24B), tick black #2B2B2B, crayon blue #3A6FE0 (lit variant #4DA3FF), chalk white #EAF0FA, paper dust #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Thước nhấc lên, vòng và dấu thập mờ dần. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: RELEASE 1/4: the ruler lifts 4 px, the ring 24 px at 40% alpha, the cross at full strength.
RELEASE 2/4: the ruler 10 px up, tilting 6 degrees, the ring 18 px at 30% alpha, the cross at 70% alpha, two paper scraps.
RELEASE 3/4: the ruler 18 px up and leaving the cell, the ring 12 px at 15% alpha, the cross at 40% alpha.
RELEASE 4/4: the ruler gone, only the cross at 20% alpha and one scrap at 15% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Castling: tia chớp đổi chỗ ở ô của pawn
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: Castling (deferred extension E3, a Page with the `swap_with_marker` effect): the pawn and the child's Chalk Block trade places. This is the swap flash played in ONE of the two cells (the pawn's cell: ivory). The pawn is pawn-owned, so this end is ivory and pale blue-white.
groups.details_en: A flash disc, then a ring with two curved arrowheads (3 px thick) chasing each other around it, then the ring fading. 5 frames, plays once at 18 fps. The same file is played in both cells at the same moment; the centre of the cell is covered only by frame 1.
groups.avoid_en: No crayon blue (blue belongs to the child), no red or coral (red is danger), no glow or bloom, no text, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks or the enemy standing in it.
groups.palette_en: ivory #FFF4D6, pale blue-white #DFEAFF, neutral dust grey #B9A98F
groups.notes_vi: Tia chớp ngà ở ô pawn khi đổi chỗ với khối phấn. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: SWAP 1/5: a ivory flash disc 10 px at the cell centre, 90% alpha.
SWAP 2/5: a ring 18 px with two curved arrowheads chasing each other around it, 85% alpha.
SWAP 3/5: the ring 26 px, the arrows turned 90 degrees, four small sparks on the ring, 65% alpha.
SWAP 4/5: the ring 30 px at 35% alpha, the arrows fading, two sparks.
SWAP 5/5: a faint 30 px ring at 12% alpha, nothing else.

groups.title_vi: Castling: tia chớp đổi chỗ ở ô của khối phấn
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16)
groups.subject_en: Castling (deferred extension E3, a Page with the `swap_with_marker` effect): the pawn and the child's Chalk Block trade places. This is the swap flash played in ONE of the two cells (the Block's cell: crayon blue). The Block was made by the child, so this end is crayon blue with chalk white.
groups.details_en: A flash disc, then a ring with two curved arrowheads (3 px thick) chasing each other around it, then the ring fading. 5 frames, plays once at 18 fps. The same file is played in both cells at the same moment; the centre of the cell is covered only by frame 1.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: crayon blue #3A6FE0 (lit variant #4DA3FF), chalk white #EAF0FA, paper dust #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Tia chớp xanh sáp ở ô khối phấn khi đổi chỗ. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: SWAP 1/5: a chalk-white flash disc 10 px at the cell centre, 90% alpha.
SWAP 2/5: a ring 18 px with two curved arrowheads chasing each other around it, 85% alpha.
SWAP 3/5: the ring 26 px, the arrows turned 90 degrees, four small sparks on the ring, 65% alpha.
SWAP 4/5: the ring 30 px at 35% alpha, the arrows fading, two sparks.
SWAP 5/5: a faint 30 px ring at 12% alpha, nothing else.

groups.title_vi: Turn the Board: vòng mũi tên xoay một phần tư
groups.anchor: centre of the turning section at (32,32); the centre 28 px stay empty so the rotating tiles show through
groups.subject_en: Turn the Board (deferred extension E5, the child's call `rotate_section`): the child's hand turns a section of the board a quarter turn (90 degrees clockwise). This is the sweep drawn over the section while it turns: four chalky crayon-blue curved arrows chasing each other a quarter of the way round, throwing off light paper dust. The tiles and props rotate in code; this only draws the swirl.
groups.details_en: A 64x64 canvas. Four curved arrow strokes (3 px thick, wobbly like wax) on a circle of 24 px radius, each about 30 degrees long with an arrowhead, rotate 90 degrees clockwise over 6 frames, plays once at 14 fps; dust specks fly off along the tangents. Larger sections use several copies placed by the engine.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: crayon blue #3A6FE0 (lit variant #4DA3FF), chalk white #EAF0FA, paper dust #F2EBDC
groups.notes_vi: Bốn mũi tên xanh sáp xoay 90 độ trên phần bàn cờ đang xoay. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: SWEEP 1/6: four arrow strokes at the north, east, south and west of a 24 px radius circle, 60% alpha, tails faint, no dust.
SWEEP 2/6: the strokes rotated 18 degrees clockwise, 80% alpha, tails stretched to 45 degrees long, two dust specks.
SWEEP 3/6: the strokes rotated 40 degrees, 95% alpha (the brightest frame), four dust specks 28 px from the centre.
SWEEP 4/6: the strokes rotated 62 degrees, 80% alpha, six dust specks.
SWEEP 5/6: the strokes rotated 82 degrees, 60% alpha, the arrowheads nearly back at the compass points, dust specks falling.
SWEEP 6/6: the strokes at 90 degrees (back at the compass points), 30% alpha, shrinking to a 20 px radius, two specks.

groups.title_vi: Turn the Board: bụi lắng khi phần bàn cờ vào chỗ
groups.anchor: centre of the section's floor contact at (24,30)
groups.subject_en: Turn the Board (deferred extension E5): the turned section clicks home. A ring of paper dust and a few cardboard crumbs rise from the seam and settle. Child motion is heavy and soft.
groups.details_en: A flat ground ring of dust that grows from 14 px to 44 px with four crumbs. 4 frames, plays once at 12 fps; the ring is a flat translucent fill.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. Crayon blue appears only as the child's own marks.
groups.palette_en: paper dust #F2EBDC, warm grey #C9BFAE
groups.notes_vi: Vòng bụi giấy tan khi phần bàn cờ xoay xong rơi vào chỗ. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: SETTLE 1/4: a dust ring 14 px wide at 80% alpha, two crumbs on the seam.
SETTLE 2/4: the ring 26 px at 65% alpha, four crumbs lifting 4 px.
SETTLE 3/4: the ring 38 px at 35% alpha, the crumbs 8 px up.
SETTLE 4/4: the ring 44 px at 12% alpha, two crumbs falling at 20% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Paper Bridge: tờ giấy bung ra thành cầu
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16): one bridge cell; drawn for an east-west bridge, the engine rotates it
groups.subject_en: Paper Bridge (deferred extension E5, the child's call): a folded sheet drops onto a gap cell and unfolds flat into a bridge, creases and a plain pencil drawing on it. The drop itself is the child's hand (a separate dust effect adds the puff); this is the paper unfolding in ONE cell. The last frame is the finished bridge cell: a flat sheet of paper (30x24 px) with thin pale creases and a pencil line.
groups.details_en: Real paper, so paper cream with pale crease lines and a graphite pencil line, no blue (the drawing on the bridge is pencil only). 6 frames, plays once at 12 fps: a small folded square lands, its flaps open east and west and it flattens across the cell.
groups.avoid_en: No red or coral (red is danger), no cursor-like arrow, no glow or bloom, no text, no hand, no actor art, nothing that hides the cell it marks. No blue of any kind.
groups.palette_en: paper cream #F2EBDC (shade #C9BFAE), crease highlight #FBF6EA, pencil line neutral graphite #6B7380
groups.notes_vi: Tờ giấy gấp rơi xuống, bung hai cánh và phẳng ra thành một ô cầu. Khung cuối khớp prop paper_bridge_h_mid. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: UNFOLD 1/6: a small folded paper square 12x12 px just touching down at the cell centre, flat folded with two crease lines.
UNFOLD 2/6: the square lands at 14 px with a 1 px bounce, the first flap lifting at the west edge.
UNFOLD 3/6: the flaps open east and west, the paper 22 px wide and 14 px tall, the creases a 'W' zigzag.
UNFOLD 4/6: the paper 30 px wide and nearly flat, the zigzag creases flattening, a graphite pencil line beginning along the middle.
UNFOLD 5/6: the paper fills the cell (30x24 px), flat, the creases thin pale lines, the pencil line complete, a tiny dust puff at each end.
UNFOLD 6/6: settled and flat, the finished bridge sheet, the dust gone.

groups.title_vi: Erase Rule Mark: bụi tẩy khi bàn tay bé chà
groups.anchor: centre of the Rule Mark cell at (24,16)
groups.subject_en: Erase Rule Mark (deferred extension E5, the child's call): the child's hand rubs a Rule Mark out with a pink eraser. This is the eraser dust over the mark's cell: soft pink-white swipe arcs, pink crumbs and a little graphite dust lifting off. It is larger and slower than the pawn's Eraser Guard crumbs. Overlay only: the Rule Mark prop, its erased frames and the hand with its eraser are separate files, and this effect never draws the mark.
groups.details_en: Two swipe arcs drawn one after the other (a 2 px band, flat translucent fill), then crumbs 2 px square and 4 px by 2 px drifting up and falling, and graphite specks. 6 frames, plays once at 10 fps (child motion is slow and heavy).
groups.avoid_en: No blue of any kind, no red or coral, no text, no hand, no eraser, no Rule Mark drawn, no glow.
groups.palette_en: pink-white #F3E1E1, eraser crumb pink #E8C6B8, neutral graphite dust #6B7380, paper white #F2EBDC. No blue.
groups.notes_vi: Hai nét chà hồng-trắng, mạt tẩy hồng và bụi chì bay lên khi bé xóa Rule Mark. Kỹ năng mở rộng (công thức §6.10), chưa có trong bản gốc; làm sau (M14, could).

poses_en: RUB 1/6: a first soft pink-white swipe arc 18 px wide across the cell centre at 80% alpha, two crumbs.
RUB 2/6: a second swipe the other way (arc 22 px) at 80% alpha, four crumbs 6 px out, a graphite smudge of dust 10 px at 50% alpha.
RUB 3/6: the swipes at 26 px, seven crumbs spread 10 px, graphite specks 6 px.
RUB 4/6: the swipe arcs fading to 40% alpha, nine crumbs 14 px wide, graphite specks rising.
RUB 5/6: the arcs gone, the crumbs falling and 16 px wide, three graphite specks at 40% alpha.
RUB 6/6: the last three crumbs at 20% alpha and one speck at 15% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Lấp lánh khi tăng Believe (HUD)
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), over one Believe crayon mark
groups.subject_en: The HUD moment when a Believe crayon mark fills (hits landed 3, Perfect Rub, rescue reunion, checkpoint, boss phase break). The mark gets a bright crayon sparkle: warm, small, earned. Believe uses two blue crayon marks.
groups.details_en: A four-point crayon-blue sparkle with two orbiting dots and a tiny wax-crumb tick. 5 frames, plays once at 14 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Ánh sao xanh sáp khi một vạch Believe được điền.

poses_en: BELIEVE +1 1/5: a single white-blue pixel at the mark's centre.
BELIEVE +1 2/5: a 7 px plus sparkle, one orbiting dot.
BELIEVE +1 3/5: a 13 px four-point star, two orbiting dots, a wax crumb tick.
BELIEVE +1 4/5: star 9 px at 60%, dots 6 px out.
BELIEVE +1 5/5: two dots at 20% alpha.

groups.title_vi: Vạch Believe bị xóa mờ khi dùng
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), over one Believe crayon mark
groups.subject_en: The HUD moment when the child's call costs 1 Believe: the crayon mark smudges away like wax rubbed with a thumb, a little blue crumble falling. Reads as paid, never as damage.
groups.details_en: The blue mark smears sideways into a smudge and a few crumbs, ending as an empty outline. 5 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Vạch sáp xanh bị quẹt mờ đi.

poses_en: BELIEVE -1 1/5: the full blue crayon mark.
BELIEVE -1 2/5: the mark smeared 3 px to the right, edges ragged.
BELIEVE -1 3/5: smudge 6 px long at 55% alpha, two crumbs.
BELIEVE -1 4/5: pale smudge 4 px at 30%, crumbs falling.
BELIEVE -1 5/5: an empty pencil outline of the mark and one crumb.

groups.title_vi: Chấm tiến độ Believe (1 trong 3 đòn)
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), over the Believe mark pip
groups.subject_en: The pip on the Believe marks that shows hit progress (1 of 3 hits landed in the current room). One small blue pip lights up with a tiny flick each hit.
groups.details_en: A small crayon-blue pip lighting with a tiny ring. 3 frames, plays once at 14 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Chấm tiến độ sáng lên mỗi lần đánh trúng.

poses_en: PIP 1/3: an empty 4 px ring.
PIP 2/3: a filled 4 px pip with a 8 px ring flash.
PIP 3/3: pip at rest, ring gone.

groups.title_vi: Quầng khi Believe đầy
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), around the Believe marks
groups.subject_en: A faint blue glow around the Believe marks when both are full (when Chalk Path is granted, Believe appears full). Quiet reassurance, no pulse faster than 1 per second.
groups.details_en: A soft blue glow ring with two tiny motes. 4 frames loop at 4 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Quầng xanh nhẹ khi Believe đầy.

poses_en: FULL 1/4: glow at 50%, motes low.
FULL 2/4: glow 60%, motes risen 2 px.
FULL 3/4: glow 50%, motes risen 4 px.
FULL 4/4: glow 40%; loops.

groups.title_vi: Believe bị xám đi (Hậu xé tranh / Vua đóng hộp)
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), over the Believe marks
groups.subject_en: The Believe marks going grey when help is disrupted (Queen's Tear the Drawing for the phase; the King's Close the Box): the crayon marks desaturate and a ragged grey pencil scribble crosses them. The saddest HUD moment: loss of the child's help made felt, not shouted.
groups.details_en: A grey pencil scribble drawing across the two marks in four strokes while the blue desaturates to grey. 6 frames, plays once at 8 fps (slow).
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Grey pencil #9A9AA3 scribble (the enemy amendment ink), faded marks #8e96a8, a last trace of blue #4da3ff in frame 1.
groups.notes_vi: Nét chì xám gạch qua hai vạch Believe, màu xanh nhạt dần thành xám.

poses_en: BELIEVE GREY 1/6: the marks in crayon blue, one thin grey stroke starting.
BELIEVE GREY 2/6: two strokes, marks 80% blue.
BELIEVE GREY 3/6: three strokes, marks 50% blue, 50% grey.
BELIEVE GREY 4/6: four strokes, marks 20% blue.
BELIEVE GREY 5/6: marks fully grey, scribble at full strength.
BELIEVE GREY 6/6: scribble at 85% (settled), marks grey.

groups.title_vi: Believe sáng lại (sau Hậu / checkpoint)
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), over the Believe marks
groups.subject_en: The marks returning to blue after the Queen phase or at a checkpoint refill: the grey scribble is rubbed out and the blue returns. Warm, a small relief.
groups.details_en: The scribble erases from right to left, blue floods back, a sparkle. 5 frames, plays once at 10 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Nét xám được xóa đi và màu xanh trở lại.

poses_en: RESTORE 1/5: grey marks with the scribble at full strength.
RESTORE 2/5: scribble erased on the right third, blue returning there.
RESTORE 3/5: scribble erased to the middle, blue spreading.
RESTORE 4/5: scribble gone, marks 80% blue, a sparkle.
RESTORE 5/5: marks fully blue, one sparkle fading.

groups.title_vi: Lấp lánh khi thêm 1 Courage (Courage Shard)
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), over a new Courage pip
groups.subject_en: A Courage pip appearing after three shards (max Courage grows): the small ivory chess-base pip pops in with a soft gold-ivory sparkle. Courage resembles three small ivory chess bases.
groups.details_en: An ivory sparkle ring and four twinkles around a small base shape. 5 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Warm ivory #fff4d6, pale blue shadow #b9c7de, a white #ffffff pixel on frame 1 only.
groups.notes_vi: Một viên Courage mới hiện ra với ánh sáng ngà.

poses_en: PIP GAIN 1/5: a white dot at the pip's position.
PIP GAIN 2/5: a small base shape 6 px with four twinkles 8 px out.
PIP GAIN 3/5: base shape 10 px full, twinkles 11 px out, a ring 18 px.
PIP GAIN 4/5: ring 22 px at 40%, twinkles fading.
PIP GAIN 5/5: pip at rest and one twinkle at 20%.

groups.title_vi: Viên Courage vỡ khi bị trúng đòn
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), over the lost Courage pip
groups.subject_en: The pip pop when the pawn takes damage (hit-stop, shake, desaturate flash, pip pop, flicker): the lost ivory base pip bursts into chips and drops its fill, leaving an empty outline. Quick (0.3 s) and clear.
groups.details_en: The pip pops into four ivory chips; the pip becomes an empty outline. 5 frames, plays once at 16 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Warm ivory #fff4d6, pale blue shadow #b9c7de, a white #ffffff pixel on frame 1 only.
groups.notes_vi: Viên Courage vỡ thành mảnh và để lại vòng rỗng.

poses_en: PIP POP 1/5: the full ivory pip with a white flash border.
PIP POP 2/5: the pip swells to 120% of its size with a hairline crack.
PIP POP 3/5: four chips fly out 6 px, the pip is a half-empty outline.
PIP POP 4/5: chips at 10 px at 50%, an empty outline pip.
PIP POP 5/5: one chip at 14 px at 20%, the empty outline at rest.

groups.title_vi: Nhịp chậm viên Courage cuối cùng
groups.anchor: centre at (12,12), around the last Courage pip
groups.subject_en: The slow pulse on the last Courage pip when only 1 is left (slow pulse with a 1.2 s cycle, never red-saturated). A cool cream ring that breathes. Reduce-flash safe: no sudden brightness change.
groups.details_en: A soft cool-cream ring around the pip. 4 frames loop at 3.3 fps (1.2 s cycle).
groups.avoid_en: No red or orange; no text; no fast flashing.
groups.palette_en: Cool cream #eef0e6 ring at 30-60% alpha.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng kem mát thở chậm quanh viên Courage cuối.

poses_en: LOW 1/4: ring 20 px at 30% alpha.
LOW 2/4: ring 22 px at 50%.
LOW 3/4: ring 24 px at 60%.
LOW 4/4: ring 22 px at 45%; loops.

groups.title_vi: Vạch Rank xanh được vẽ thêm (sau boss)
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), at the next free tally slot
groups.subject_en: A new blue crayon tally mark drawn into the Rank label after a boss (Rank 2 to 8 is the child's blue tally marks; the word 'level' never appears). A single stroke drawn with a little wax crumb, then rest.
groups.details_en: A short vertical crayon stroke growing from top to bottom, then a tiny sparkle. 6 frames, plays once at 10 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text; no numerals.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Vạch xanh được vẽ thêm vào nhãn Rank.

poses_en: TALLY 1/6: the stroke's top 3 px.
TALLY 2/6: stroke 6 px.
TALLY 3/6: stroke 9 px, a wax crumb.
TALLY 4/6: stroke 12 px full, rounded end.
TALLY 5/6: a small sparkle at the stroke's end.
TALLY 6/6: stroke at rest at 100%.

groups.title_vi: Ô kỹ năng hiện ra (HUD)
groups.anchor: centre at (16,16), over the new HUD skill slot
groups.subject_en: A HUD slot fading in when a skill is unlocked (the HUD shows only unlocked skills). The slot gets a ring of gold sparkles over 0.5 s.
groups.details_en: A soft gold ring expanding from the slot with four sparkles. 6 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Golden yellow #ffd34e, pale gold #fff2a8, cream.
groups.notes_vi: Ô kỹ năng mới hiện lên với vòng sáng vàng.

poses_en: SLOT 1/6: a gold dot grid hint where the slot will be.
SLOT 2/6: ring 20 px, four sparkles.
SLOT 3/6: ring 28 px at 70%, sparkles 4 px.
SLOT 4/6: ring 32 px at 45%.
SLOT 5/6: ring faded, two sparkles 25%.
SLOT 6/6: one sparkle 10%.

groups.title_vi: Ô kỹ năng sẵn sàng sau hồi chiêu
groups.anchor: centre at (16,16), over a HUD skill slot
groups.subject_en: A small ring pulse when a skill finishes its cooldown (Pencil 1.25 s, Rule Step 4.0 s): quiet confirmation that the verb is back. Not a flash.
groups.details_en: A cream ring contracting onto the slot then a tiny twinkle. The 24 px slot sits centred in the 32x32 canvas, so the widest ring is 30 px across and the whole effect stays inside the canvas. 4 frames, plays once at 14 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Cream #fff4d6, pale gold #fff2a8.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng kem nhỏ co lại vào ô khi hồi chiêu xong.

poses_en: READY 1/4: a 2 px thick ring 30 px across at 25% alpha just outside the 24 px slot (it fits inside the 32x32 canvas).
READY 2/4: the ring contracts to 28 px across at 45%.
READY 3/4: ring 26 px across at 60%, a twinkle at the top-right corner.
READY 4/4: ring gone, twinkle at 30%.

groups.title_vi: Ô kỹ năng bị khóa khi bấm (chưa có kỹ năng)
groups.anchor: centre at (16,16), over the HUD slot
groups.subject_en: HUD feedback when the player presses a locked skill or a skill on cooldown (req 29: refuse the sword before the unlock with HUD feedback): a small grey puff and two shake ticks on the slot, quiet and kind, never red.
groups.details_en: A grey puff with two shake ticks left and right. 4 frames, plays once at 14 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Warm grey #c9bfae, graphite #6b7380 ticks.
groups.notes_vi: Hạt bụi xám và hai nét rung khi bấm kỹ năng chưa dùng được.

poses_en: DENIED 1/4: puff 6 px, two 3 px ticks.
DENIED 2/4: puff 9 px, ticks 5 px.
DENIED 3/4: puff 11 px at 50%, ticks fading.
DENIED 4/4: puff 12 px at 20%.

groups.title_vi: Ô mục tiêu cho lời gọi của đứa trẻ (hợp lệ)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: Marker for the cell(s) the selected child call will affect (Chalk Path: up to 3 gap cells ahead; Chalk Block: the free cell ahead). Crayon-blue = child-made. No cursor: the cells are selected along the facing line. Hand-drawn blue corner brackets and a soft chalk dot grid.
groups.details_en: Four crayon-blue corner L-brackets (5 px arms, 3 px thick, wobbly like wax) and a loose 3x3 dotted chalk grid inside at 30% alpha. 4 frames loop at 6 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text; no cursor-like arrow.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Khung xanh sáp quanh ô mục tiêu của lời gọi.
groups.used_in: R call target, H1 Block Tower door, bs4, bt2, dh1

poses_en: TARGET 1/4: brackets at rest, dots at 30%.
TARGET 2/4: brackets pulled 1 px in, dots 38%.
TARGET 3/4: brackets pulled 2 px in, dots 45%.
TARGET 4/4: brackets pulled 1 px in; loops.

groups.title_vi: Ô mục tiêu gọi miễn phí (TraversalGap)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: The target marker for a FREE cast at a TraversalGap with no hostile alive (0 Believe, the hand still shows). Distinguished from the paid one by a small cream star at the centre (a gift), so the player sees 'this one is free'. Crayon blue brackets.
groups.details_en: Four crayon-blue corner L-brackets (5 px arms, 3 px thick, wobbly like wax) and a loose 3x3 dotted chalk grid at 30% alpha, plus a small cream four-point star at the centre and a dashed chalk line along the cell. 4 frames loop at 6 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel. Star in cream #fff4d6.
groups.notes_vi: Giống ô hợp lệ nhưng có sao kem ở giữa: lần này miễn phí.

poses_en: FREE 1/4: brackets at rest, star 100%.
FREE 2/4: brackets 1 px in, star 85%.
FREE 3/4: brackets 2 px in, star 70%.
FREE 4/4: brackets 1 px in, star 85%; loops.

groups.title_vi: Từ chối lời gọi (không tốn Believe)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: Rejection feedback for an invalid call (no gap in range, a unit on the target cell, an occupied cell): costs nothing. A grey pencil scribble crossing the cell and a small puff, kind not punishing (never red, never a harsh buzz).
groups.details_en: A loose grey X scribbled in two strokes and a small puff. 5 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Graphite grey #6B7380 strokes, warm grey puff #c9bfae.
groups.notes_vi: Dấu X bút chì xám nhẹ nhàng, không đỏ.

poses_en: REJECT 1/5: the first diagonal stroke 20 px.
REJECT 2/5: the second stroke crossing it, a puff 6 px.
REJECT 3/5: both strokes at full strength, puff 10 px.
REJECT 4/5: strokes at 50%, puff 12 px at 40%.
REJECT 5/5: strokes at 15%.

groups.title_vi: Bóng bàn tay phủ ô mục tiêu (0.6 s)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: The hand's shadow falling over the target cell during the 0.60 s wind-up of a call (the shadow crossing the board IS the telegraph of a child call; the Queen or enemies can disrupt it). A soft cool shadow with a blue crayon edge; the pawn may move meanwhile.
groups.details_en: A soft dark-blue shadow filling the cell at 30% alpha with a dithered edge and a thin blue crayon outline. 4 frames loop at 6 fps; the shadow gets darker toward the end.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text; must not hide the cell content for a decision.
groups.palette_en: Blue-charcoal #2a3550 at 30-45% alpha, crayon blue #4da3ff outline.
groups.notes_vi: Bóng bàn tay phủ lên ô trong 0.6 giây trước khi phấn hiện ra.

poses_en: SHADOW 1/4: shadow 30% alpha, outline 60%.
SHADOW 2/4: shadow 34%, outline 70%.
SHADOW 3/4: shadow 40%, outline 80%.
SHADOW 4/4: shadow 45%, outline 90%; loops.

groups.title_vi: Lời gọi bị phá (Hậu xé tranh)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: A call being disrupted on its target cell (Queen's Tear the Drawing, enemies disrupting help): the blue chalk marks tear like paper, a ragged grey rip and torn blue-crayon scraps blowing away. Dramatic but fair: the player sees the help was taken.
groups.details_en: A ragged tear across the cell, six torn blue crayon bits and grey scribble. 6 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Paper white #f2ebdc lips, crayon blue #4da3ff scraps, graphite #6B7380.
groups.notes_vi: Lời gọi bị xé đôi, các mảnh sáp xanh bay đi.

poses_en: DISRUPT 1/6: a hairline rip across the blue marks.
DISRUPT 2/6: the rip opens 4 px, two scraps lift.
DISRUPT 3/6: rip 8 px, six scraps in the air, grey scribble.
DISRUPT 4/6: rip 8 px, scraps 14 px out.
DISRUPT 5/6: rip closing, scraps 20 px out at 40%.
DISRUPT 6/6: grey scribble fading at 20%.

groups.title_vi: Bụi giấy khi bàn tay đặt xuống
groups.anchor: centre at (24,20), under the hand's placement point
groups.subject_en: Paper dust puffed where the child's hand places a block or lands (the first scripted block at tb3, hub gifts, Chalk Block): heavy and soft, slower than the pawn's effects (child motion is slower and heavier).
groups.details_en: A wide low puff of paper dust with three paper scraps. 6 frames, plays once at 10 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Paper white #f2ebdc, warm grey #c9bfae.
groups.notes_vi: Bụi giấy bung ra dưới tay, chậm và nặng.

poses_en: PLACE DUST 1/6: a tight puff 10 px wide.
PLACE DUST 2/6: puff 22 px, two scraps.
PLACE DUST 3/6: puff 34 px, three scraps rising.
PLACE DUST 4/6: puff 42 px at 60%, scraps 8 px up.
PLACE DUST 5/6: puff 46 px at 30%.
PLACE DUST 6/6: faint dust 46 px at 10%.

groups.title_vi: Gió giấy khi bàn tay đến
groups.anchor: centre at (24,24), radial from the hand's arrival point
groups.subject_en: Paper wind (fantasy effects are crayon light, paper wind, block debris) as the hand arrives over the board: a gust of paper scraps and dust scatter outward. Slow, soft, atmospheric.
groups.details_en: Eight paper scraps swirling outward on a faint spiral. 6 frames, plays once at 8 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Paper white #f2ebdc, warm grey #c9bfae.
groups.notes_vi: Gió thổi giấy vụn khi bàn tay hạ xuống.

poses_en: GUST 1/6: four scraps near the centre.
GUST 2/6: eight scraps 8 px out on a spiral.
GUST 3/6: scraps 14 px out, tumbling.
GUST 4/6: scraps 20 px out at 70%.
GUST 5/6: scraps 24 px at 40%.
GUST 6/6: two scraps at 28 px at 15%.

groups.title_vi: Vạch kiểm xanh trên biển lối ra (đã dọn phòng)
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), on the cleared room's exit marker
groups.subject_en: A blue tally tick the child draws on each cleared room's exit marker (zero-text presence layer). One small stroke drawn onto the marker; the last frame is the resting mark.
groups.details_en: A short blue crayon stroke drawn in diagonal-then-vertical like a tally tick. 5 frames, plays once at 10 fps; hold the last frame.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Vạch kiểm xanh nhỏ được vẽ lên biển lối ra.

poses_en: TALLY TICK 1/5: the stroke's first 3 px.
TALLY TICK 2/5: stroke 6 px, a wax crumb.
TALLY TICK 3/5: stroke 9 px, rounded end.
TALLY TICK 4/5: stroke at full 11 px, a tiny sparkle.
TALLY TICK 5/5: stroke at rest.

groups.title_vi: Dấu sáp xanh nhỏ khi đứa trẻ phát hiện pawn (B1)
groups.anchor: centre at (16,16), above the pawn's cell
groups.subject_en: After the Black Pawn Captain becomes a toy, the hand stops above the pawn and draws a small blue mark, and the desk light snaps on. This is the mark being drawn: a small blue crayon circle with a tiny star next to it, the child's first sign. The pawn bows (afraid, then hesitant).
groups.details_en: A hand-drawn blue crayon circle (14 px) being drawn in one wobbly stroke and a small 5 px star appearing beside it. 6 frames, plays once at 8 fps; hold the last frame.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Vòng tròn sáp xanh nhỏ kèm ngôi sao: dấu hiệu đầu tiên của đứa trẻ.

poses_en: NOTICE MARK 1/6: the circle's first quarter arc.
NOTICE MARK 2/6: half the circle.
NOTICE MARK 3/6: three quarters, wax crumb.
NOTICE MARK 4/6: the circle closed, wobbly.
NOTICE MARK 5/6: a small star starts at the right.
NOTICE MARK 6/6: circle and star at rest.

groups.title_vi: Vết sáp xanh cào qua 1 ô (T4)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); art fills the 32x32 cell
groups.subject_en: The crayon scratch that runs across one tile in T4 (the child's first trace): the line's drawing is an optional 'trace' effect when the pawn first steps near. The static scratch is a prop drawn by the props lane; this is its draw-on. Rough, hurried, a child's scratch rather than a drawing.
groups.details_en: A rough blue crayon scratch crossing the cell diagonally in three quick strokes. 6 frames, plays once at 12 fps.
groups.avoid_en: No red; no text.
groups.palette_en: Crayon blue #4da3ff, pale blue #bfe3ff, deeper edge #2f6fc9, white core pixel.
groups.notes_vi: Vết cào sáp xanh vội vàng của đứa trẻ.

poses_en: SCRATCH 1/6: the first stroke's start.
SCRATCH 2/6: first stroke across 20 px.
SCRATCH 3/6: second stroke crossing it.
SCRATCH 4/6: third short stroke.
SCRATCH 5/6: a crumb or two on the floor.
SCRATCH 6/6: the final scratch at rest.

groups.title_vi: Đường sáp xanh dẫn ra ngoài bàn cờ (đoạn giữa)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (16,16); drawn pointing EAST
groups.subject_en: A MIDDLE segment of the blue crayon line at the Desk that leads the pawn off the board's edge in the ending (the playable refusal of promotion: the exit beyond the board's edge is cued by this line; the child leaves it there). Quiet and glowing softly, hand-drawn.

groups.title_vi: Bóng chạm sàn dưới nhân vật cỡ s
groups.anchor: centre (16,8), at the actor's feet
groups.subject_en: The ground shadow under pawn-family actors, white soldiers, the Crayon Target and the hub's white pawns. Actor sprites carry no baked floor shadow, so this separate sprite gives them height and weight on the board (shadows establish height but never hide telegraphs).
groups.details_en: A flat soft contact shadow, 1x1 pixels, NO outline: a charcoal-blue #1E2230 oval in two stepped rings (outer ring 24x8 px, inner ring 14x4 px; outer ring 20 percent alpha, inner ring 40 percent alpha); the edge is a crisp stepped pixel line, never feathered. Centred on the canvas; the engine places it under the actor's anchor and never rotates it. It never hides a telegraph: it is light enough that the dark-orange and coral cell markers stay readable on top of it. The shadow fits the 32x32 cell of the piece it sits under, like the piece itself: the outer ring leaves at least 2 px of empty canvas at its left and right ends, so it never touches a canvas edge.
groups.avoid_en: an outline, a gradient, a highlight, a floor tile or any object, text, a hard black fill
groups.palette_en: shadow charcoal-blue #1E2230 at 20 and 40 percent alpha
groups.notes_vi: Bóng nền mềm, không viền; engine đặt dưới điểm neo của nhân vật.

groups.title_vi: Viên bi thuỷ tinh lăn (Marble Launcher, biến thể hoãn)
groups.anchor: centre at (8,8), the marble's centre; drawn rolling EAST (east = right); the engine moves it along the lane and rotates it in 90 degree steps
groups.subject_en: The projectile of the deferred Marble Launcher (extension recipe E7): a smoky glass toy marble rolling along its row or column. It is the object the telegraphed lane is about, so it must read as a small hard round toy at a glance, rolling and not sliding. The launcher's own sprite and sounds already exist as separate files.
groups.details_en: A round marble about 12 px across centred on the 16x16 canvas, smoky grey glass with one twisted ribbon inside that makes the rolling visible, a small ivory highlight dot on the upper left, a darker crescent along the lower right. 4 frames, loops at 12 fps; the ribbon turns 45 degrees per frame and the pattern repeats every half turn, so frame 4 flows into frame 1.
groups.avoid_en: No coral red, no crayon blue, no golden yellow (red is imminent damage only, blue is the child, yellow is interactable); no text; no gore; no bloom; no actor art; must not hide the chess square or the hero. No motion trail and no baked shadow (the engine draws the shadow).
groups.palette_en: smoky glass #7C8794 (light #B7C0CB, shadow #3C4350), twist ribbon #3C4350, highlight ivory #F1E8D2.
groups.notes_vi: Viên bi thuỷ tinh khói, 4 khung lăn lặp; vẽ hướng sang phải, engine xoay theo làn.
groups.used_in: Marble Launcher (deferred E7), along its telegraphed row or column

poses_en: ROLL 1/4: the smoky glass marble 12 px across, its inner twist ribbon vertical, the ivory highlight dot upper left.
ROLL 2/4: the same marble with the ribbon turned 45 degrees clockwise (it rolls east), the highlight dot still upper left.
ROLL 3/4: the ribbon horizontal, a slightly thicker dark crescent along the lower right edge.
ROLL 4/4: the ribbon at 135 degrees; the pattern repeats every half turn so the loop returns to frame 1 without a jump.

groups.subject_en: The small puff where a Marble Launcher's marble hits the hero or stops against an obstacle and vanishes: a cream flash, a little dust ring and a few tiny glass chips. It is feedback, not a telegraph, so it carries no danger colour.
groups.details_en: One-cell effect, 4 frames, plays once at 14 fps, impact on frame 2. Chips are 2 px, drawn in the same smoky glass as the marble. Any dust ring that fades is a flat translucent fill at the opacity written in the frame.
groups.avoid_en: No coral red, no crayon blue, no golden yellow (red is imminent damage only, blue is the child, yellow is interactable); no text; no gore; no bloom; no actor art; must not hide the chess square or the hero.
groups.palette_en: flash ivory #F1E8D2, dust #CFC6B2, glass chips #B7C0CB (shadow #3C4350).
groups.notes_vi: Bụi nhỏ khi bi trúng/dừng, 4 khung, không dùng màu cảnh báo.

groups.title_vi: Búa lên dây cót đập xuống ô phía trước và nảy lại (Wind-Up Hammer, biến thể hoãn)
groups.anchor: cell centre at (24,24), the centre of the struck cell
groups.subject_en: The impact of the deferred Wind-Up Hammer's slam (extension recipe E7): the spring-mounted wooden mallet hits the cell in front of it, then rebounds on its spring. Two clips: `slam` (the hit on the floor) and `rebound` (the quiet metallic twang that follows). The hammer's own sprite and sounds already exist as separate files.
groups.details_en: slam: 5 frames, plays once at 14 fps, impact on frame 2: a cream flash, a flat shockwave ring that grows to the cell edge, short diagonal floor cracks, dust and 2 px wood chips. rebound: 3 frames, plays once at 12 fps, starting right after the last slam frame: three thin curved tin-grey twang arcs and one small dust puff. Fading parts are flat translucent fills at the opacity written in the frame. Heavy and woody, a toy that hits hard, not an explosion.
groups.avoid_en: No coral red, no crayon blue, no golden yellow (red is imminent damage only, blue is the child, yellow is interactable); no text; no gore; no bloom; no actor art; must not hide the chess square or the hero. No cartoon boing stars, no smoke column.
groups.palette_en: flash ivory #F1E8D2, wood chips #C89B5E (shade #8E6D3F), tin grey #9AA3AD, dust #CFC6B2, floor cracks #5F5C66.
groups.notes_vi: Hai clip: slam (5 khung, đập) và rebound (3 khung, nảy lại bằng lò xo); không có màu cảnh báo.
groups.used_in: Wind-Up Hammer (deferred E7), the struck cell in front of it

SLAM 2/5: IMPACT, the brightest frame: the flash 28 px with a thin white-hot rim, a flat shockwave ring 32 px across, the four cracks 10 px long, six 4 px dust puffs on the ring.
SLAM 3/5: the ring 44 px across at 70 percent opacity, eight 2 px wood chips flung 12 px out, the dust puffs 8 px, the cracks held.
SLAM 4/5: the ring 48 px across at 40 percent opacity, the chips falling 16 px from the centre, a dust cloud 24 px across at 60 percent opacity, the cracks fading to half length.
SLAM 5/5: dust motes at 15 percent opacity, two wood chips at rest, the cracks gone.
REBOUND 1/3: three thin curved tin-grey twang arcs 10 px long above the cell centre and one 6 px dust puff.
REBOUND 2/3: the arcs spread to 14 px at 60 percent opacity, a single wood chip drops, the dust puff 8 px.
REBOUND 3/3: the arcs 18 px at 25 percent opacity and one dust mote left.
